E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure login system with mobile number and OTP verification to ensure that only authorized doctors can access the application. Implement additional security measures for re-authentication to maintain data security after periods of inactivity.
E001.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to log in using my mobile number and receive an OTP so that my access is secure and verified.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor inputs mobile number and requests an OTP.
System sends an OTP to the provided mobile number.
Doctor enters the received OTP to log in.
System verifies OTP and grants access if correct.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the doctor login screen, including input fields for the mobile number and a button to request an OTP. Ensure that the design is user-friendly and accessible on various devices. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Implement the backend logic to generate an OTP when a mobile number is entered and the OTP request button is clicked. This includes server-side validation of the mobile number format. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Set up integration with an SMS gateway to send the OTP to the doctor's mobile number. Configure the system to handle potential errors like SMS send failure and provide appropriate feedback to the user. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Develop the functionality for doctors to input the received OTP and submit it for verification. This includes creating an input field and submission button on the existing login interface. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Create a secure method on the backend to verify the entered OTP against the generated OTP. This should include a time limit for OTP validity and error handling for incorrect entries. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Implement login success and failure responses. On successful OTP verification, grant access to the doctor and redirect to the dashboard. On failure, display an appropriate error message and allow re-attempt. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Ensure all data transmitted during the login process is secured using HTTPS to prevent interception of sensitive information such as mobile numbers and OTPs. Estimated completion: 1 day.

Conduct testing across different devices and networks to ensure the login functionality works reliably and securely under various conditions. This includes testing edge cases such as multiple simultaneous login attempts and rapid re-requesting of OTP. Estimated completion: 3 days.
Prepare documentation that includes details about the login process, system architecture related to login, and guidelines for troubleshooting common login issues. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Plan and execute a training session for the support team on the new login system to ensure they can effectively assist doctors and address any OTP related queries or issues. Estimated completion: 1 day.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure login system with mobile number and OTP verification to ensure that only authorized doctors can access the application. Implement additional security measures for re-authentication to maintain data security after periods of inactivity.
E001.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want the application to automatically log me out after 5 minutes of inactivity and require re-authentication so that unauthorized access is prevented if I leave my device unattended.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Detect inactivity for a period of 5 minutes.
Automatically log out the user after 5 minutes of inactivity.
Prompt for mobile number and OTP upon next action after auto-logout.
Verify OTP and grant access for successful re-authentication.

Tasks.Description: Implement inactivity detection mechanism in the application to monitor user activity and identify when no actions have been taken for a period of 5 minutes. Set a deadline to complete this task within 1 week.
Develop functionality to automatically log out users after 5 minutes of detected inactivity. Include unit tests to ensure this feature works reliably. This task should be completed within 2 weeks.
Create a login prompt that appears after automatic logout due to inactivity. This prompt should request the mobile number and OTP from the user. Aim to have this task done within 1.5 weeks.
Set up the OTP verification system to validate the user upon re-entry after an automatic logout. Include security measures to handle potential brute force attacks. Schedule completion within 3 weeks.

Integrate the inactivity detection, automatic logout, login prompt, and OTP verification features into the existing doctor's application platform, ensuring smooth operation and user experience. Allocate 1 week for integration and testing.

Perform comprehensive testing of the entire inactivity detection and automatic logout process to ensure functionality aligns with the acceptance criteria. Dedicate 2 weeks for multiple rounds of testing and adjustments based on feedback.
Document the development process, user manual, and troubleshooting guide for the new automatic logout and re-authentication feature. Completion expected in 1 week.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure login system with mobile number and OTP verification to ensure that only authorized doctors can access the application. Implement additional security measures for re-authentication to maintain data security after periods of inactivity.
E001.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want the system to limit the number of failed login attempts to prevent unauthorized access from brute force attacks.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Limit the number of consecutive failed login attempts to 5.
Lock the account temporarily for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.
Notify the doctor via SMS when the account is locked and unlocked.

Tasks.Description: Implement a counter mechanism in the authentication system to track the number of consecutive failed login attempts by a doctor. The counter resets after a successful login or after the account is unlocked. Time estimated to implement: 2 days.

Develop functionality to lock a doctor's account for 15 minutes upon reaching the threshold of 5 consecutive failed login attempts. The lockout mechanism should prevent further login attempts during this period. Time estimated to implement: 3 days.

Integrate SMS notification system to alert doctors when their account is locked and when it is unlocked. This involves configuring the SMS gateway and ensuring the messages are sent securely and reliably. Time estimated to implement: 3 days.

Create automated tests to verify that the lockout mechanism and SMS notifications function correctly under various scenarios, such as multiple failed attempts, successful login after lockout, and reception of SMS notifications. Time estimated to complete: 2 days.

Coordinate with the security team to review and approve the implementations for handling failed login attempts to ensure it meets security standards and complies with privacy regulations. Time estimated to complete: 1 day.

Schedule a deployment of the new login security features to the staging environment for further integration testing and to gather initial feedback from a select group of users. Time estimated for deployment and initial feedback collection: 2 days.

Prepare and update the doctor user guide and training materials to include information on new security measures related to failed login attempts and account lockout procedures. Time estimated to complete: 2 days.

Monitor and analyze the system logs post-deployment to ensure that the new features are functioning as intended and to identify any potential issues or improvements in the account lockout and SMS notification processes. Time estimated for ongoing monitoring and analysis: 5 days.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure login system with mobile number and OTP verification to ensure that only authorized doctors can access the application. Implement additional security measures for re-authentication to maintain data security after periods of inactivity.
E001.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want my session to be secure through the use of HTTPS and unique session identifiers so that my interactions with the app are secure and private.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ensure all data transmission is done over HTTPS.
Generate a unique session identifier for each login session.
Ensure session identifiers are invalidated upon logout.

Tasks.Description: Implement HTTPS for all app data transmissions: Configure the application server to enforce HTTPS protocol for all incoming and outgoing connections to ensure secure data transmission. This task should be completed within 1 week and involves updating server settings and acquiring necessary SSL/TLS certificates.

Develop functionality to generate unique session identifiers: Create a method in the authentication service to generate a unique session identifier for each user upon login. This identifier will be used to track the session's validity and must be implemented securely using cryptographic methods. Target to complete this task in 2 days.

Store session identifiers securely: Ensure that session identifiers are stored securely on the server using encryption. This task involves setting up encrypted storage solutions and should be completed within 3 days.

Implement session identifier invalidation on logout: Develop a logout function that invalidates the session identifier when a user logs out. This function must securely erase or overwrite the session identifier. Plan for 2 days to implement and test this functionality.

Test session management security: Conduct thorough testing to verify that all data transmission is done over HTTPS, unique session identifiers are generated and stored securely, and that identifiers are properly invalidated upon logout. Allocate 5 days for a complete testing cycle including unit, integration, and system tests.

Document the implementation process: Create detailed documentation on the implementation of secure session management, including how to enforce HTTPS, manage session identifiers, and handle session expiration. This task should take 2 days and will involve writing up the technical processes and configuration steps.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a secure login system with mobile number and OTP verification to ensure that only authorized doctors can access the application. Implement additional security measures for re-authentication to maintain data security after periods of inactivity.
E001.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to have the option to enable two-factor authentication for added security.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Provide an option in the profile settings to enable two-factor authentication.
Send an OTP to the registered mobile number everytime a login attempt is made if two-factor is enabled.
Require the OTP along with the usual password for successful login if two-factor is enabled.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface option in the profile settings for enabling two-factor authentication, ensuring it is intuitive and clearly labeled.
Implement backend logic to update and store the two-factor authentication setting in the doctor's profile securely.
Develop functionality that triggers an OTP to be sent to the doctor's registered mobile number each time a login attempt is made when two-factor authentication is enabled.
Integrate with an SMS gateway provider (like Twilio) for reliable delivery of OTPs.
Modify the existing login process to require input of both the password and the OTP when two-factor authentication is enabled.
Set up server-side validation to check the correctness of the OTP along with the password during the login process.
Implement frontend changes to prompt for an OTP on the login screen when two-factor authentication is enabled.
Carry out comprehensive testing to ensure that enabling/disabling two-factor authentication updates the system correctly and that the login process works as expected with two-factor authentication.
Deploy updates to a staging environment to perform integration and security testing.
Prepare documentation for end-users on how to enable and use two-factor authentication, including troubleshooting common issues.
Roll out the feature to a limited user group to gather initial feedback and adjust based on the responses.
Plan and execute a full deployment of the feature, including monitoring and support for any raised issues post-launch.

E002.Epic Description: Provide doctors with the ability to access and review comprehensive patient profiles, including health assessments and medical history, through a streamlined interface. This should help doctors prepare for and conduct consultations more effectively, although they should not be able to modify patient-entered data.
E002.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to securely log in using my mobile number and OTP so that I can access patient data securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor can enter mobile number on login screen.
OTP is sent to the doctor's mobile number.
Doctor can enter OTP to successfully log in.
System locks out the user after three unsuccessful OTP attempts.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the login screen where doctors can enter their mobile number. The design should be intuitive and accessible, ensuring compliance with accessibility standards. Estimated duration: 2 days.

Implement the front-end code for the login screen based on the approved designs. This includes form fields for mobile number entry and OTP entry, and a submit button. Use responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across devices. Estimated duration: 3 days.
Develop the backend API to receive the mobile number from the login form and trigger the OTP service. Ensure that the API can handle concurrent requests securely. Estimated duration: 3 days.
Integrate an OTP service provider (like Twilio) to send an OTP to the mobile number provided by the doctor. Set up configurations for OTP validity and rate limits. Estimated duration: 2 days.
Develop the backend logic to verify the entered OTP against the sent OTP. Include logic to handle cases where the OTP is incorrect or has expired. Estimated duration: 3 days.

Implement a lockout mechanism that activates after three consecutive unsuccessful OTP verification attempts. The lockout should temporarily disable login capability for the user for a predefined time period. Estimated duration: 2 days.

Create unit tests for each component of the login process, including mobile number input, OTP sending, OTP verification, and the lockout mechanism. Ensure comprehensive coverage to prevent regressions. Estimated duration: 3 days.

Conduct integration testing to ensure that the new login system works seamlessly with the existing patient data access system. Tests should include scenarios for both successful and unsuccessful logins. Estimated duration: 2 days.

Develop and integrate detailed logging for each step of the login process to aid in debugging and tracking user activities. Ensure that sensitive data like OTPs are not logged. Estimated duration: 2 days.

Prepare documentation for the new login functionality, detailing the flow, configurations, and how to handle common issues like OTP failures or account lockouts. The documentation should be accessible to both developers and support teams. Estimated duration: 2 days.

Plan and execute a phased rollout of the new login system, initially releasing the feature to a small percentage of users to monitor performance and gather feedback before a full rollout. Estimated duration: 1 week.

This should help doctors prepare for and conduct consultations more effectively, although they should not be able to modify patient-entered data.
E002.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to access and review patient profiles and their medical history so that I can prepare for and tailor my consultations effectively.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor can select a patient from a patient list in the app.
Patient’s complete profile along with medical history is viewable but not editable.
Profiles include all AI-generated notes and health assessments.
Doctors can navigate through different sections of the medical history smoothly.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the patient list where doctors can easily select a patient. Include search and filter functionalities to handle large datasets. Expected completion: 3 days.
Implement backend API to retrieve patient list from the database securely. Ensure that the API can handle search queries and filter parameters. Expected completion: 4 days.
Develop the functionality to display a patient's complete profile and medical history in a read-only format to ensure data cannot be edited by the doctor. Expected completion: 5 days.

Integrate the display of AI-generated notes and health assessments into the patient profile view. Fetch data from AI services and display them appropriately in the profile. Expected completion: 4 days.

Create a navigation system within the patient profile view that allows doctors to smoothly transition between different sections of the medical history. Implement UI components like tabs or side navigation menus. Expected completion: 3 days.
Conduct a security review to ensure that all data transmissions are secure and that patient data is only accessible by authorized doctors. Expected completion: 2 days.
Test the patient selection functionality with mock data to ensure robust search and filtering capabilities. Expected completion: 2 days.
Perform end-to-end testing of the patient profile viewing functionality to ensure all components work together seamlessly and the data is displayed correctly. Expected completion: 3 days.
Organize a training session for the development team on HIPAA compliance and data handling protocols to prevent unauthorized data modification. Expected completion: 1 day.
Prepare deployment plans and migration strategies for introducing the new patient profile viewing capabilities into the existing system without downtime. Expected completion: 2 days.
Schedule a review meeting with stakeholders to demonstrate the new functionalities and gather feedback for any necessary adjustments. Expected completion: 1 day.

This should help doctors prepare for and conduct consultations more effectively, although they should not be able to modify patient-entered data.
E002.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to utilize an AI-powered medical scribe to document observations during consultations so that I can minimize manual data entry and focus more on patient care.
Story Acceptance Criteria: AI scribe activates by voice command or button within the app during consultation.
AI accurately transcribes spoken medical notes into text.
Transcribed notes can be reviewed and saved by the doctor immediately after the consultation.
Transcribed data is securely saved in patient's digital profile.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface button and voice command activation feature for the AI-powered medical scribe within the doctor's consultation application. Ensure the design is intuitive and easily accessible during consultations. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Integrate speech recognition technology that supports medical terminology into the application to enable the AI-powered medical scribe to accurately transcribe spoken notes. Choose a speech recognition provider and configure the API for medical contexts. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Develop functionality for the AI scribe to transcribe spoken words into text in real-time during a medical consultation. Include error handling to manage and log transcription inaccuracies. Estimated completion time: 3 weeks.

Implement a review interface within the app where doctors can immediately review, edit, and confirm the accuracy of the transcribed medical notes post-consultation. Ensure this interface is user-friendly and allows for quick modifications. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Create a secure backend process to save the transcribed and reviewed medical notes into the patient's digital profile. Ensure the data is encrypted and conforms to HIPAA regulations for data security. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Conduct thorough testing of the AI-powered medical scribe feature to ensure accuracy in diverse real-world scenarios and compliance with medical documentation standards. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing with real doctors. Estimated completion time: 3 weeks.

Prepare documentation for the AI scribe feature, covering user instructions, troubleshooting, and FAQs. Ensure the documentation is clear and accessible within the app. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Set up a feedback mechanism for doctors to report any issues or suggest improvements for the AI scribe feature, directly within the app. Use this feedback for continuous improvement of the system. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

This should help doctors prepare for and conduct consultations more effectively, although they should not be able to modify patient-entered data.
E002.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to review and validate patient onboarding data inputted by AI tools to ensure accuracy before it's added to the patient's official file.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctors can access a section for AI-inputted data review in the patient’s profile.
AI-inputted data should be clearly marked and differentiated from manually entered data.
Doctors can confirm the accuracy with a digital signature or correctness checkbox.
Once validated, data is marked as reviewed and locked for editing.

Tasks.Description: Design a separate section in the patient's profile interface specifically for reviewing AI-inputted data. Ensure it is visually distinct from sections containing manually entered data. Completion of the design by the UI/UX team within 1 week.
Develop backend functionality to tag and store data as 'AI-inputted' vs 'manually entered'. This should be implemented in the database schema by the backend team within 2 weeks.

Implement frontend functionality for doctors to access the AI-inputted data review section. This includes navigation changes and ensuring compatibility with various devices. Task to be completed by the frontend development team within 1.5 weeks.

Create a digital signature or checkbox feature that allows doctors to confirm the accuracy of the AI-inputted data. This requires frontend components and backend logic to record the validation status. Estimated completion time is 1 week.

Once validated by the doctor, lock the AI-inputted data for editing and mark it as reviewed in the system. Develop the backend logic to update data status and restrict further modifications. Task to be completed within 1 week.
Conduct integration tests to verify that the AI-inputted data can be reviewed, validated, and locked properly without impacting other patient data. Allocate 1 week for testing.
Plan a training session for doctors to educate them on how to use the new AI-data review functionality. Prepare materials and schedule the session to be conducted within 2 weeks after deployment.

Deploy the new changes to a staging environment for UAT (User Acceptance Testing) involving real users (doctors). Gather feedback and make required adjustments. Set aside 2 weeks for UAT and final adjustments.

This should help doctors prepare for and conduct consultations more effectively, although they should not be able to modify patient-entered data.
E002.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to securely log out of the application so that I can ensure no unauthorized access to patient data on my device.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logout option is easily accessible from any screen within the app.
Session is completely terminated upon logging out.
Post logout, re-login requires mobile number and OTP verification to access.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI button for logout that is consistently visible on all screens of the doctor's interface. This button should be intuitive and easily accessible to ensure compliance with the first acceptance criteria. Estimated time for completion: 2 hours.

Implement backend functionality to terminate the session completely upon clicking the logout button. This includes clearing all session-related data and cookies to prevent unauthorized access, aligning with the second acceptance criteria. Estimated time for completion: 4 hours.

Develop a re-authentication process that triggers when a user attempts to log back in after logging out. This involves setting up the mobile number input, OTP request dispatch, and OTP verification mechanisms, ensuring it meets the third acceptance criteria. Estimated time for completion: 6 hours.
Conduct integration testing to verify that the logout functionality works seamlessly across different devices and does not retain any session data post-logout. Estimated time for completion: 3 hours.
Perform security testing to ensure that after logout, re-authentication is mandatory and no session data can be accessed without proper OTP verification. Estimated time for completion: 3 hours.

Prepare documentation for the logout and re-authentication functionality, detailing the process and any necessary steps or considerations for future maintenance and updates. Estimated time for completion: 2 hours.

E003.Epic Description: Incorporate AI-powered tools such as a medical scribe to transcribe doctor’s observations during patient interactions and an AI-powered form input system to organize consultation data into structured patient notes. This will reduce manual data entry and enhance the accuracy of medical records.
E003.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want an AI-powered medical scribe to transcribe my verbal observations during patient interactions so that I can maintain accurate and comprehensive medical records without manual data entry.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system accurately transcribes spoken words into text.
Transcriptions are timestamped and correctly attached to the patient’s record.
The system allows doctors to review and edit transcriptions before finalizing.
Transcriptions are completed in real-time with minimal delay.

Tasks.Description: Research and select AI transcription technologies that are suitable for clinical environments, focusing on accuracy and real-time processing capabilities. Completion due within 2 weeks.

Develop a module that integrates the chosen AI transcription technology into the existing healthcare platform, ensuring it captures and transcribes spoken words during doctor-patient interactions. Target completion in 4 weeks.

Implement timestamp functionality in the transcription module to tag each transcribed entry with the exact date and time of the doctor's narration. This task should be completed within 1 week after the integration.

Create a user interface that allows doctors to review, edit, and finalize transcriptions before they are added to the patient's medical record. Include functionality for easy navigation and editing. Scheduled finish in 3 weeks.

Ensure that the transcription process is completed in real-time with minimal delay. Test and optimize the system for performance under typical clinical interaction loads. Completion targeted within 2 weeks of the first deployment.

Conduct a pilot testing phase with a select group of doctors to use the transcription system in live patient interactions, gathering feedback on transcription accuracy, ease of review, editing capabilities, and real-time performance. Complete pilot testing and feedback collection within 4 weeks.

Analyze feedback from pilot testing to identify any issues or areas for improvement in the transcription system. Plan adjustments and optimizations based on actual user experiences. Completion of analysis and planning improvements should be done within 1 week post-pilot testing.
Implement the necessary improvements and optimizations to the transcription system based on feedback from the pilot testing. This task should be completed within 3 weeks after receiving feedback.

Plan and conduct a final round of testing to confirm that all issues identified during pilot testing have been resolved and that the system meets all specified acceptance criteria. Finish comprehensive testing within 2 weeks.

Prepare and conduct training sessions for all doctors on how to effectively use the new AI-powered medical scribe system. Include guides on accessing, reviewing, editing, and finalizing transcriptions. Schedule and complete training within 2 weeks following the final testing phase.
Deploy the AI-powered transcription system across all clinical settings after successful training and final testing. Go-live scheduled within 1 week post-training.

E003.Epic Description: Incorporate AI-powered tools such as a medical scribe to transcribe doctor’s observations during patient interactions and an AI-powered form input system to organize consultation data into structured patient notes. This will reduce manual data entry and enhance the accuracy of medical records.
E003.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to use an AI-powered form input system that automatically organizes consultation data into structured patient notes so that I can ensure data is systematically captured and easily retrievable.
Story Acceptance Criteria: AI form input accurately captures and organizes data from consultations into predefined categories.
Structured data is editable and can be reviewed by doctors before saving.
System provides templates for different types of consultations.
Integration with EHR (Electronic Health Record) systems for seamless data transfer.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop an AI form input system that captures and categorizes consultation data into predefined templates. Ensure the system uses natural language processing to accurately interpret and organize data from spoken or typed input. Deadline: 3 weeks.

Create an interface for doctors to review, edit, and confirm the accuracy of the structured data captured by the AI form input system. This interface should allow modifications before final submission and saving of the consultation notes. Deadline: 2 weeks.

Develop a variety of templates for different types of consultations, such as general check-ups, follow-up visits, and specialized assessments. Collaborate with clinical experts to ensure these templates meet medical standards and are comprehensive. Deadline: 4 weeks.

Integrate the AI form input system with existing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems used by the healthcare facility. This task involves working with IT to ensure data from the AI system can be seamlessly transferred and stored in the EHR without manual intervention. Deadline: 5 weeks.

Conduct a pilot test of the AI form input system with a small group of doctors to gather feedback on the accuracy of data capture and the usability of the editing interface. Use the feedback to make necessary adjustments. Deadline: 1 week post-completion of development tasks.

Organize a training session for doctors to demonstrate how to use the new AI form input system and educate them on how to effectively utilize the templates and editing features. Deadline: 1 week after pilot testing.

Implement security measures to ensure that the data captured and transferred by the AI form input system is compliant with healthcare regulations, such as HIPAA in the U.S., ensuring data privacy and protection. Deadline: Ongoing, with initial setup completed before pilot testing.

E003.Epic Description: Incorporate AI-powered tools such as a medical scribe to transcribe doctor’s observations during patient interactions and an AI-powered form input system to organize consultation data into structured patient notes. This will reduce manual data entry and enhance the accuracy of medical records.
E003.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want an interface where I can review, validate, and approve the AI-generated patient notes so that I can ensure the accuracy and completeness of the medical records.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The review interface is user-friendly and allows for easy editing and approval of notes.
Doctors receive notifications for records that require review.
Changes and approvals are logged for audit purposes.
Review process is integrated within the doctors’ workflow, ensuring minimal disruption.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly interface for reviewing AI-generated patient notes. Include features for easy navigation, editing, and approval of notes to meet the criteria of user-friendliness and ease of use. Estimated completion: 3 days.
Develop a notification system to alert doctors when AI-generated notes are ready for review. Ensure compatibility across various devices and platforms used by doctors. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Implement logging functionality to record all changes and approvals made to AI-generated notes. Ensure logs capture user ID, timestamp, and nature of the change for audit purposes. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Integrate the review and approval process for AI-generated notes into the existing workflow of doctors. This may involve modifying the doctor's dashboard to include access to the review interface and ensuring minimal disruption to their current processes. Estimated completion: 5 days.

Conduct usability testing with a group of doctors to ensure the review interface meets their needs and is intuitive. Gather feedback and make necessary adjustments based on the findings. Estimated completion: 2 weeks.
Set up a monitoring system to track the usage and performance of the review interface, ensuring it operates efficiently and reliably within the doctor's workflow. Estimated completion: 1 week.

E003.Epic Description: Incorporate AI-powered tools such as a medical scribe to transcribe doctor’s observations during patient interactions and an AI-powered form input system to organize consultation data into structured patient notes. This will reduce manual data entry and enhance the accuracy of medical records.
E003.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want the AI tools to integrate seamlessly with our existing healthcare systems so that I can maintain a consistent workflow and avoid technology conflicts.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ensure compatibility with major EHR systems used in healthcare.
Data synchronization must be secure and comply with healthcare regulations.
System should support data export and import functionalities.
Minimal downtime during integration with real-time data handling capabilities.

Tasks.Description: Conduct a compatibility assessment of the AI tools with major EHR systems used in healthcare. Document the requirements for each system, identify common standards and protocols needed for integration. (Timeline: 2 weeks)

Develop a secure data synchronization module that ensures encrypted transmission of data between the AI tools and existing EHR systems. Include mechanisms such as SSL/TLS for data in transit and AES for data at rest. Perform security audits to comply with healthcare regulations. (Timeline: 4 weeks)

Implement data import and export functionalities in the AI tools. This should support various data formats common in healthcare systems (e.g., HL7, FHIR). Ensure these functionalities allow seamless data flow without information loss. (Timeline: 3 weeks)

Plan and execute a phased integration process to minimize downtime in clinical operations. Include steps for pre-integration testing, live deployment in a controlled environment, and full rollout. Ensure real-time data handling capabilities are tested and optimized during the integration. (Timeline: 5 weeks)

Set up a pilot testing phase post-integration to collect feedback and monitor the system's performance in real-time. Adjust integration mechanics based on feedback to reduce any disruptions and optimize workflows. (Timeline: 2 weeks)

Develop comprehensive documentation and training materials for system administrators and IT support teams on managing and troubleshooting the integrated AI tools within the EHR systems. (Timeline: 2 weeks)

Conduct regular review and maintenance sessions post-integration to ensure that all components of the AI tools function seamlessly with the EHR systems and any new updates in either system are accommodated. (Timeline: Ongoing, first review after 1 month)

E003.Epic Description: Incorporate AI-powered tools such as a medical scribe to transcribe doctor’s observations during patient interactions and an AI-powered form input system to organize consultation data into structured patient notes. This will reduce manual data entry and enhance the accuracy of medical records.
E003.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to ensure that the AI tools have secure access controls and comply with data privacy regulations so that patient information is protected against unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System requires strong authentication mechanisms for access.
All data transfers are encrypted.
Compliance with HIPAA or relevant data protection regulations.
Activity logs are maintained for security audits.

Tasks.Description: Design a strong authentication mechanism for AI tools access, incorporating multi-factor authentication (MFA) with options such as biometrics, SMS OTP, or app-based OTP. Plan to complete the design within 2 weeks.
Implement encryption protocols for all data transfers involving AI tools, using AES-256 encryption standard. Target implementation and testing completion within 3 weeks.

Consult with a HIPAA compliance expert to review the current AI tool's data handling methods and ensure they meet HIPAA regulations. Schedule the consultation within 1 week and plan for potential adjustments based on feedback to be deployed over the next 4 weeks.

Develop and integrate a system for real-time activity logging that captures all user interactions with AI tools, including access times, types of data accessed, and user identification. Aim to have a working prototype within 4 weeks.

Conduct a security audit of the newly implemented authentication and encryption measures by a third-party security firm to ensure they are robust. Organize the audit to be completed within 6 weeks from the implementation date.

Prepare and conduct training sessions for the medical staff on the new security features and compliance measures of the AI tools. Plan to roll out training sessions within 2 weeks after all security measures are implemented.

Set up continuous monitoring and alerting for any unauthorized access attempts or non-compliance with HIPAA regulations, using an existing security information and event management (SIEM) system. Complete setup within 5 weeks.

E004.Epic Description: Integrate access to a library of medical resources, research papers, and continuing education materials to help doctors stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options. Include functionalities for sharing relevant information with patients to aid in their understanding of their condition and treatment.
E004.Story Description: As a doctor, I want to access an integrated library of medical resources and research papers so that I can stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ensure the library is regularly updated with the latest research and publications.
Provide search and filter capabilities to quickly find relevant documents.
Allow downloading and offline access to materials.

Tasks.Description: Design and set up a database schema for storing medical resources and research papers, ensuring fields for metadata such as publication date, author, and topic are included. Task to be completed within 1 week by the database team.

Develop a backend API to handle CRUD operations for the medical resources library. This includes endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting documents, with completion expected in 2 weeks by the backend development team.

Implement a periodic update mechanism to fetch the latest research and publications from predefined medical journals and databases. This task should be automated using a scheduled script or service, developed over 3 weeks by a backend developer.

Create an indexing and search functionality using Elasticsearch or a similar service to allow fast and efficient searching of documents based on various criteria. Implementation should be done in 2 weeks by the search engine specialist.

Develop front-end interfaces for accessing the library, with features for searching, filtering, and sorting documents. Include responsive design to ensure usability across devices. Task to be completed in 3 weeks by the front-end team.

Enable document download functionality with secure access, ensuring materials can be saved for offline use. Include PDF and other relevant formats. This should be implemented in 1 week by a full-stack developer.

Test all functionalities including database operations, search and filter capabilities, and download mechanisms to ensure they work seamlessly and securely. Testing phase to be completed in 1 week by the QA team.

Deploy the library system to a staging environment for internal review and feedback. Adjust based on feedback and prepare for production deployment. Staging review and adjustments to be completed in 1 week.

Document the usage instructions and technical details of the medical resources library for both internal maintenance and end-user guidance. Documentation to be prepared in 1 week by the technical writing team.
Monitor and optimize the performance of the library system post-launch, addressing any issues related to load times or user accessibility. Ongoing monitoring to be set up by the IT support team.

E004.Epic Description: Integrate access to a library of medical resources, research papers, and continuing education materials to help doctors stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options. Include functionalities for sharing relevant information with patients to aid in their understanding of their condition and treatment.
E004.Story Description: As a doctor, I want to have access to continuing education modules so that I can further my knowledge and meet my professional development requirements.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Modules must be accredited and count towards continuing education credits.
Include a variety of formats such as video, articles, and interactive content.
Track progress and completion of modules.

Tasks.Description: Research and partner with accredited education providers to source continuing education modules that are eligible for credits. Aim to finalize partnerships within 4 weeks.

Design a content management system (CMS) interface for uploading and categorizing educational modules in various formats (videos, articles, interactive content). Development should start by week 5 and end by week 8.
Implement a multimedia handling system to support video and interactive content without performance issues. Plan integration tests with the CMS in week 9.
Develop a user interface within the doctor’s portal for accessing continuing education modules. Include filters for module format and accreditation status. Scheduled for completion by week 10.
Create a back-end system to track each doctor's progress and completion of modules. Include functionality to save and resume modules. Target to complete by week 12.
Test the entire module access and tracking system for bugs and usability issues in a staging environment before going live in week 13.
Prepare and conduct a training session for doctors on how to use the continuing education features by the end of week 14.
Launch the continuing education module feature and monitor usage and performance metrics for the first month post-launch.

E004.Epic Description: Integrate access to a library of medical resources, research papers, and continuing education materials to help doctors stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options. Include functionalities for sharing relevant information with patients to aid in their understanding of their condition and treatment.
E004.Story Description: As a doctor, I want to easily share relevant medical information with patients so that they can better understand their condition and treatment options.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Enable secure sharing of information directly to patients' mobile devices or emails.
Allow customization of what information is shared to suit individual patient needs.
Provide templates for common conditions and treatments for quick sharing.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a secure API to facilitate the transfer of medical information from the doctor's portal to the patient's mobile device or email. Ensure end-to-end encryption for data security. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Create a user interface on the doctor's portal for selecting the type of information to be shared with patients. This interface should include checkboxes or dropdown menus for different categories of information. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Implement a customization feature in the doctor's portal that allows doctors to tailor the information based on the specific needs of each patient, such as adjusting the level of detail or adding personalized notes. Estimated completion time: 1.5 weeks.

Develop a set of pre-defined templates for common conditions and treatments that doctors can quickly select and send to patients. These templates should be editable to accommodate modifications by the doctor. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations such as HIPAA when sharing medical information to protect patient privacy. Include consent forms or disclaimers as necessary. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Test the entire system for security vulnerabilities and ensure that only authorized personnel can access and send patient information. Include penetration testing and encryption validation. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Prepare training materials and conduct training sessions for doctors on how to use the new features for sharing information with patients. Focus on security practices and customization options. Estimated completion time: 1 week.
Roll out the feature in a phased manner starting with a pilot group of doctors and gather feedback to make necessary adjustments before a full-scale launch. Estimated completion time: 3 weeks.

E004.Epic Description: Integrate access to a library of medical resources, research papers, and continuing education materials to help doctors stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options. Include functionalities for sharing relevant information with patients to aid in their understanding of their condition and treatment.
E004.Story Description: As a doctor, I want to provide educational tools to patients so that they can learn about their health conditions in an interactive manner.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Include multimedia resources such as videos, infographics, and diagrams.
Interactive quizzes to test patients' understanding of their conditions.
Tools should be accessible via mobile and web platforms to accommodate all patients.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop an interactive multimedia content library that includes videos, infographics, and diagrams. Ensure compatibility across both mobile and web platforms. (Deadline: 3 weeks from project start, Responsible: Front-end Development Team)

Implement interactive quizzes related to various health conditions within the educational tools section. Include features for instant feedback and scoring to engage users. (Deadline: 4 weeks from project start, Responsible: Back-end Development Team)

Ensure all multimedia content and interactive tools are fully responsive and accessible on mobile devices and web browsers, testing on a range of devices and operating systems. (Deadline: 5 weeks from project start, Responsible: QA Team)
Create backend APIs to manage and serve multimedia content and quiz data dynamically, ensuring scalability and security. (Deadline: 3 weeks from project start, Responsible: Back-end Development Team)

Set up a content management system (CMS) for admins to easily add, update, or remove multimedia resources and quizzes without developer intervention. (Deadline: 4 weeks from project start, Responsible: Back-end Development Team)
Develop user interfaces for educational tools that are intuitive and user-friendly, with clear navigation and accessible design. (Deadline: 3 weeks from project start, Responsible: UI/UX Design Team)

Integrate analytics to track user engagement with multimedia resources and quizzes, allowing for future improvements based on user interaction data. (Deadline: 6 weeks from project start, Responsible: Data Analysis Team)

Conduct user acceptance testing with a group of doctors and patients to gather feedback on the usability and educational value of the multimedia resources and quizzes. (Deadline: 7 weeks from project start, Responsible: QA Team)

Prepare documentation and training materials for system administrators and end-users to facilitate the adoption and effective use of the new educational tools. (Deadline: 8 weeks from project start, Responsible: Technical Writing Team)

Launch a pilot program to introduce the educational tools to a limited user group before a full-scale rollout, to address any unforeseen issues and gather initial user feedback. (Deadline: 9 weeks from project start, Responsible: Project Management Team)

E004.Epic Description: Integrate access to a library of medical resources, research papers, and continuing education materials to help doctors stay updated on the latest medical advances and treatment options. Include functionalities for sharing relevant information with patients to aid in their understanding of their condition and treatment.
E004.Story Description: As a doctor, I want to receive feedback on the educational material provided to patients so that I can improve the resources and their delivery.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Implement a feedback mechanism where patients can rate and comment on materials.
Collect and analyze feedback data to identify areas for improvement.
Provide monthly reports on feedback trends and suggested enhancements.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a feedback form for educational materials that allows patients to submit a star rating (1-5) and text comments. Ensure fields for rating and comments are mandatory. Set implementation completion within 2 weeks.

Develop a backend service to securely store patient feedback on educational materials. Include fields for user ID, material ID, rating, comments, and timestamp. Ensure data privacy compliance. Completion due within 3 weeks.
Create a data aggregation and analysis tool to process feedback from educational materials, categorize comments, and calculate average ratings and trends. Plan to deploy the tool within 4 weeks.

Implement a reporting module to generate monthly feedback reports on educational materials. Reports should include average ratings, common themes in comments, and recommendations for improvements. Schedule the first report generation within 6 weeks.

Integrate feedback mechanisms directly into the educational materials section of the app, with clearly visible feedback buttons or links. Test user interface for ease of use and visibility. Complete integration and testing in 3 weeks.

Set up a scheduler in the system to automatically generate and distribute feedback trend reports to doctors on the first day of each month. Ensure secure email distribution. Complete setup within 1 week.

Conduct a training session for doctors on how to interpret feedback reports and how to implement suggested enhancements based on patient feedback. Arrange the session within 7 weeks from project start.

Perform comprehensive testing of the entire feedback system, including form submission, data storage security, analysis tool accuracy, and report generation, to ensure all components function as expected. Complete testing phase within 8 weeks.

E005.Epic Description: Allow doctors to manage their own profiles within the app, including updating personal and professional information such as hospital affiliation and contact details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to update my personal information such as name, profile picture, and contact details so that my profile remains current and accurate.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor can access their profile edit page.
Fields for name, profile picture, and contact details are editable.
Changes are saved and immediately reflected in the doctor's profile.
Ensure data validation for contact details.

Tasks.Description: Implement backend API endpoint to handle GET requests for fetching existing doctor profile information for the profile edit page. Ensure it retrieves name, profile picture, and contact details. Task should be completed by the backend team within 2 days.

Design and develop the front-end interface for the doctor's profile edit page. The interface should include form fields for name, profile picture, and contact details. Include a 'Save' button to submit changes. UI/UX team should complete this within 3 days.

Implement backend API endpoint for POST requests to update doctor profile information including name, profile picture, and contact details. This task includes ensuring that the new data replaces the old data in the database. Backend team should complete this within 2 days.

Create client-side JavaScript functionality to handle the submission of the profile edit form, including data validation for contact details (e.g., valid email format, phone number length). This task should be completed by the front-end team in 1 day.

Integrate the front-end profile edit form with the backend API endpoints. This includes fetching current profile data to populate the form and sending updated data to the backend. This integration task should be handled by the front-end team and completed in 2 days.

Implement immediate feedback on the UI after successful profile update, such as a confirmation message or a visual indication that changes have been saved. Front-end team should implement this within 1 day.

Conduct comprehensive testing of the new profile edit functionality, covering both front-end and backend systems. This includes testing form submission, data validation, API endpoints, and database updates. QA team should complete testing in 3 days.

Set up security measures to ensure that only the authenticated doctor can access and edit their profile. This includes implementing proper authentication checks and possibly using session tokens. Security team to review and implement necessary measures within 2 days.
Prepare deployment scripts and migration strategies to deploy the new profile edit functionality to the production environment. DevOps team should prepare and test deployment within 2 days.

Document the new profile management features including details on how to access the profile edit page, how to edit fields, expected validation errors, and troubleshooting steps. Technical writing team should complete documentation within 3 days.

E005.Epic Description: Allow doctors to manage their own profiles within the app, including updating personal and professional information such as hospital affiliation and contact details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to update my hospital affiliation details so that my current working institution is accurately reflected in my profile.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor can access a section in the profile to update hospital affiliation.
Doctor can select their affiliated hospital from a pre-populated list of registered institutions.
Updates are saved and visible on the profile immediately after submission.
System verifies the affiliation with the hospital database before updating.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI section in the doctor’s profile for updating hospital affiliation details. Include a dropdown menu populated with registered hospitals. Ensure the UI is intuitive and easy to access as per acceptance criteria.
Develop the backend logic to fetch the list of registered hospitals from the hospital database. This list will populate the dropdown menu in the doctor’s profile update section.

Implement a feature that allows doctors to select their new hospital affiliation from the dropdown menu and submit the update. This should trigger a backend process to update their profile information.
Create an API endpoint that handles the submission of updated hospital affiliation details. This endpoint should update the doctor’s profile in the database and return a success response.
Develop a verification process that checks the selected hospital against the hospital database to confirm its existence and validity before updating the doctor’s profile.

Integrate real-time feedback on the profile update page showing the status of the update (e.g., updating, successful update, error in update) to enhance user experience and align with the acceptance criteria.
Set up a notification mechanism that alerts the doctor once the hospital affiliation update is successfully saved. This could be in the form of a popup message or a banner on the profile page.

Implement rigorous security measures to ensure that the hospital affiliation update process is secure and that data integrity is maintained. This includes using HTTPS for data transmission and implementing proper authentication and authorization checks.
Conduct unit testing of the new hospital affiliation update feature to ensure that it works as expected. This includes testing the UI, API endpoint, database updates, and verification process.
Plan and execute integration testing with the hospital database to ensure that the verification and update processes interact correctly with external systems.

Prepare and update system documentation to include details on the new hospital affiliation update feature, covering both the technical implementation and the user interface. Ensure that the documentation is clear and accessible for future reference.
Schedule a training session for doctors to demonstrate the new hospital affiliation update feature, ensuring they understand how to access and use it effectively.

E005.Epic Description: Allow doctors to manage their own profiles within the app, including updating personal and professional information such as hospital affiliation and contact details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to update my medical credentials including my MD ID so that my qualifications are up-to-date for patient and peer review.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctor can edit their MD ID and other credentials through their profile settings.
System checks the validity of the MD ID against a medical credentials database.
Updates are saved and reflected in the profile once validated.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface for doctors to access and edit their MD ID and other credentials in the profile settings section of the app. This task includes creating input fields and edit buttons in the UI. Ensure the interface is user-friendly and accessible. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Develop backend functionality to handle the submission of updated medical credentials, including MD ID. This includes setting up API endpoints to receive data from the frontend, process it, and prepare for validation. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Integrate a service to check the validity of the MD ID against a medical credentials database. This task involves creating a connection to an external database or service that can validate MD IDs, handling the validation logic, and returning the validation status. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Implement logic to save the updated MD ID and credentials to the doctor's profile in the database only if the validation is successful. Ensure transactional integrity, such that no data is saved unless all validations pass. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Create unit tests to ensure that the edit functionality works correctly, especially the validation checks and data saving logic. This includes writing tests for successful edits, handling of invalid data, and failure to pass validation. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Update the user documentation to include instructions on how to update MD IDs and other credentials, highlighting the validation process and any constraints related to credentials update. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

Conduct a peer review session to evaluate the implemented features for editing MD ID and credentials, focusing on code quality, security measures, and adherence to the acceptance criteria. Estimated time: 1 day.

Deploy the changes to a staging environment to simulate real-world usage and conduct integration testing, ensuring that the new functionality interacts correctly with existing features and external systems. Estimated time: 2 days.

Prepare and deliver a training session for the support team on the new credentials updating feature, explaining the validation process, potential user queries, and troubleshooting common issues. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

Monitor and gather feedback on the functionality from real users in the production environment post-deployment, and plan for any necessary adjustments or improvements based on the feedback. Ongoing for 2 weeks post-launch.

E005.Epic Description: Allow doctors to manage their own profiles within the app, including updating personal and professional information such as hospital affiliation and contact details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to manage the privacy settings of my profile to control what information is visible to patients and other doctors.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Doctors can access privacy settings from their profile dashboard.
Options available to set visibility for contact details, hospital affiliation, and credentials.
Changes are applied immediately and affect what others see on the doctor’s profile.

Tasks.Description: Design the User Interface (UI) for the privacy settings section in the doctor's profile dashboard, ensuring it is intuitive and accessible. This task should be completed within 3 working days.

Implement front-end functionality for the privacy settings section, allowing doctors to view and change visibility options for their contact details, hospital affiliation, and credentials. Target to complete this implementation in 5 working days.

Develop back-end services to handle the updating of privacy settings. This includes API endpoints to retrieve current settings and to save updated settings. This task should be completed within 5 working days.

Integrate front-end and back-end services for the privacy settings feature, ensuring changes are reflected immediately in the doctor's profile and visible to others based on the updated settings. Set a deadline of 2 working days for integration testing.

Conduct a series of tests including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing, to ensure that the functionality meets all acceptance criteria and is bug-free. Allocate 3 working days for this task.

Prepare and update system documentation to include details about the new privacy settings feature, ensuring that technical support teams and developers can understand and maintain the feature. Complete this documentation within 2 working days.

Plan and execute a training session for doctors to educate them on how to use the new privacy settings feature effectively. This should be scheduled within 1 week of feature deployment and take approximately 2 hours.

Deploy the new privacy settings feature to the production environment after all testing is completed and ensure it goes live by the end of the development cycle, approximately 20 working days from the start of the project.
Monitor the feature post-deployment for any potential issues and gather feedback from users to ensure it meets their needs effectively. Continuous monitoring for the first month after release.

E005.Epic Description: Allow doctors to manage their own profiles within the app, including updating personal and professional information such as hospital affiliation and contact details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.
E005.Story Description: As a Doctor, I want to securely logout from the application to ensure my account remains secure when not in use.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logout button is easily accessible from any screen within the doctor’s interface.
Upon logout, the user is redirected to the login screen.
Session is terminated on the server to prevent unauthorized access.

Tasks.Description: Design a universally accessible logout button that is visible and can be reached from any interface screen within the doctor's app module. Task must be completed within 2 days.

Implement a logout function that ensures the user is redirected to the login screen after successful logout. Include a session validation check to confirm logout before redirection. Task must be completed within 3 days.

Develop backend functionality to terminate all active sessions on the server once a logout request is made. This includes invalidating session tokens. Task should be tested to ensure no data leakage or unauthorized access post-logout. Task must be completed within 4 days.

Conduct integration testing to verify that the logout button reliably performs the required actions across all platforms (web, iOS, Android). This should include testing the session termination on the server. Task must be completed within 3 days after the development tasks are completed.

Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with a focus group of doctors to ensure the logout functionality meets their expectations and is easy to use from any screen within the app. Collect feedback and make necessary adjustments. Task must be scheduled within 1 week of completing integration testing.

Document the logout feature implementation details, including the user flow, server-side session management, and secure redirection protocols. Ensure the documentation is ready for review by the system security team to validate compliance with best practices. Documentation should be completed within 2 days post-development.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to register using my mobile number and OTP so that I can securely create my own profile.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Registration page accessible from the mobile app
Fields for mobile number entry
OTP sent to entered mobile number
Validation of OTP to complete registration
Confirmation message upon successful registration

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a registration page in the mobile app that is user-friendly and accessible directly from the main menu. This task should be completed within 1 week by the UI/UX design team.

Develop input fields specifically for mobile number entry on the registration page, including appropriate validation rules (e.g., format, mandatory field). This should be achieved by the front-end development team within 3 days.

Integrate the backend system to send an OTP to the entered mobile number using an SMS gateway service. This should include error handling for failed SMS sends and be completed within 2 weeks by the backend development team.

Implement OTP validation logic to verify the user-entered OTP against the server-stored value. This should include a timeout for OTP validity and should be completed within 1 week by the backend development team.

Upon successful registration, trigger a confirmation message to the user and redirect them to their newly created profile page. This task should be implemented by the front-end team and should take 2 days.

Conduct comprehensive testing, including unit tests for each component (input validation, OTP sending and validation) and integration tests for the registration process. This testing phase should be completed within 1 week by the QA team.

Ensure the registration page and process are compliant with data protection regulations, including secure handling and storage of mobile numbers and OTPs. Compliance verification should be completed within 1 week by the security team.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to link my profile to a hospital using a security code so that my medical records can be integrated and accessed by the hospital.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Option to enter a security code provided by the hospital
Verification of the security code
Linking patient profile to hospital upon successful verification
Ability to unlink profile from the hospital
Confirmation messages for both linking and unlinking actions

Tasks.Description: Design the UI element for entering the security code into the patient's profile page, ensuring it is user-friendly and accessible.
Implement the backend service to verify the entered security code against the hospital's database, using secure API calls.
Develop the functionality to link the patient's profile to the hospital database upon successful security code verification, ensuring data consistency and integrity.
Create a feature in the patient profile settings that allows for unlinking from the hospital, including backend support to securely sever connections.
Implement confirmation dialogs that appear after successful linking and unlinking actions, providing clear feedback to the user.
Conduct testing to ensure that the security code entry, verification, linking, and unlinking processes all handle common edge cases and error handling smoothly.
Prepare and deploy database migrations necessary for storing links between patient profiles and hospitals, ensuring all privacy and security standards are met.
Create comprehensive documentation on the process of linking and unlinking patient profiles to hospitals for future reference and support personnel.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to update my personal information such as age, gender, and contact details so that my profile remains up-to-date.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access to edit personal information from profile settings
Fields to update age, gender, phone number, and other personal details
Save changes functionality
Confirmation message upon successful update

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the personal information editing section in the profile settings. Ensure it is accessible and user-friendly, with clear labels for editing age, gender, phone number, and other personal details. Completion target: 3 days.

Implement input fields for age, gender, phone number, and other personal details within the profile settings page. Validate inputs to ensure data integrity (e.g., phone numbers in correct format, age as numeric input). Completion target: 5 days.

Develop the backend functionality to update and store the changed personal information in the database securely. This includes handling POST requests when a user submits their updated details. Completion target: 5 days.
Create a 'Save Changes' button on the profile update page. Ensure it triggers the correct events to capture and process the updated information when clicked. Completion target: 2 days.

Implement a confirmation message that appears to users upon successfully updating their profile. This message should confirm that their personal information has been updated. Completion target: 2 days.

Conduct unit testing on the new fields and functionality to ensure that all data is processed correctly and that no existing features are broken. Include tests for successful data submission and error handling. Completion target: 3 days.

Schedule a review session with the QA team to go over the implemented features and make sure everything aligns with the user story and acceptance criteria. Gather feedback and implement necessary adjustments. Completion target: 2 days after initial testing.

Prepare user documentation and help content for updating personal information on the profile settings page. This should guide users on how to access and use the new functionality. Completion target: 3 days.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to update my health information like allergies, medications, and chronic conditions to keep my health records accurate.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access to a section for health information within the profile
Options to add or modify information about allergies, medications, and conditions
Save functionality for any changes made
Confirmation message upon successful updates

Tasks.Description: Design a dedicated UI section for health information management within the patient profile. This should include tabs or sections for allergies, medications, and chronic conditions. Ensure the design is user-friendly and accessible. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Implement the backend API to handle CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for health information such as allergies, medications, and chronic conditions. Ensure APIs are secure and data is validated before processing. Estimated completion: 5 days.

Develop the frontend functionality to interact with the backend API. This includes forms to add and modify health information and mechanisms to retrieve and display existing data. Include input validations to prevent incorrect data entry. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Integrate a save button with functionality to update the user's health information in the database. Ensure changes are only submitted when the user confirms, to prevent accidental data loss. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Implement a confirmation message that appears after successful updating of health information. This should be clear and indicate exactly what information has been updated. Estimated completion: 1 day.

Conduct comprehensive testing to ensure that all components (UI, APIs, data validation, save functionality) work seamlessly together and data integrity is maintained. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Prepare documentation that covers the new health information management features, including screenshots and step-by-step instructions on how to use the new features. This documentation should be accessible from within the app. Estimated completion: 2 days.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to manage my security settings, including changing passwords and setting up security questions, to enhance the security of my account.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access to security settings from the profile menu
Options to change password and setup or change security questions
Effective validation on all inputs
Confirmation message upon successful changes

Tasks.Description: Design the UI for the security settings menu accessible from the profile menu ensuring it aligns with the app's overall design language and is user-friendly. Include options for password change and security question setup. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Implement the backend API to support password changes. This should include secure handling of passwords, hashing for storage, and integration with the existing authentication system. Estimated completion: 5 days.
Develop functionality for adding and modifying security questions. This includes storing questions and hashed answers securely in the database. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Create input validation rules for new passwords and security answers to ensure they meet security standards (e.g., minimum length, complexity). Implement these validations on both the client and server sides. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Integrate real-time feedback on input validation for password and security question answers in the UI to enhance user experience by instantly informing users if their inputs are valid. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Program confirmation messages to be displayed upon successful update of security settings. Ensure these messages are clear and provide reassurance that the changes have been securely saved. Estimated completion: 1 day.
Conduct a security review of the new features, including penetration testing and code review, to ensure there are no vulnerabilities introduced. Estimated completion: 5 days.
Prepare user documentation and help content for managing security settings, including how to change passwords and set up security questions. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Develop an automated test suite to test the new security settings features comprehensively, including UI, API, and integration tests. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Stage the changes in a pre-production environment and conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the updates meet user expectations and acceptance criteria. Gather feedback and make necessary adjustments. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Plan and execute the deployment of the security settings update to the production environment, including database migrations and application updates. Ensure minimal downtime during deployment. Estimated completion: 2 days.

E001.Epic Description: Enable patients to register, create, and manage their profiles using mobile number and OTP, allowing them to link/unlink to a hospital, update personal and health information, and manage security settings.
E001.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to be able to securely log out from the application to ensure my account is secure when not in use.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logout option easily accessible in the application
Confirmation prompt to avoid accidental logouts
Redirection to the login screen post-logout
Clear session data on logout to prevent unauthorized access

Tasks.Description: Design a logout button that is easily accessible across all screens of the mobile application, ensuring it is visible and reachable irrespective of the user's current navigation within the app. Task should be completed within 3 days.

Implement a confirmation prompt when the user selects the logout option. This prompt should ask for user confirmation to avoid accidental logouts, and include both 'Confirm' and 'Cancel' options. The implementation should be tested and completed within 2 days.

Develop the functionality that redirects users to the login screen upon successful logout. Ensure the transition is smooth and the login screen is ready to accept new login credentials. This task should be achieved within 2 days.
