Ensure all session data is cleared from the device upon logout. This includes removing any cached user credentials, session tokens, and any sensitive information stored temporarily. Include automated tests to verify that data clearance is thorough and secure. Expected completion time is 3 days.

Conduct integration testing to ensure that the logout process works seamlessly and satisfies all acceptance criteria. This should include testing on multiple devices to ensure compatibility and should be completed within 2 days.

Review the security standards applied to the logout process to ensure it complies with industry best practices for data protection and privacy. This review should be completed in 1 day and might involve consultation with a security expert.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to be able to register and create a profile using my mobile number and OTP so that I can securely access the health assessment tools.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Successful registration using mobile number and OTP
Ability to create and edit a personal profile
System verifies the user's identity before profile creation

Tasks.Description: Design a mobile-friendly registration form that includes fields for entering a mobile number and requesting an OTP. The design should ensure clarity and ease of use on various devices.

Implement backend functionality to send an OTP to the mobile number entered by the user. This should include integration with an SMS gateway that can deliver OTPs effectively across different mobile carriers.
Develop frontend functionality for users to enter the received OTP and submit for verification. This should include input validation to ensure OTP format is correct before submission.
Create backend logic to verify the entered OTP against the one sent to the user's mobile phone. Upon successful verification, allow the user to proceed to profile creation.

Implement a user profile creation interface post-OTP verification, allowing the user to enter personal information such as name, age, and contact details. Include input fields and appropriate validations for each.
Set up database schemas to store user registration and profile information securely, ensuring data privacy and protection standards are met.
Develop functionality for users to edit their profile after creation. This should include mechanisms to securely authenticate the user before allowing access to edit operations.
Implement system checks to verify the user's identity using the mobile number and OTP before creating the profile, ensuring no duplicate profiles are created for the same mobile number.

Conduct thorough testing of the registration and profile creation process, covering scenarios such as invalid inputs, failed OTP verification, and successful profile creation, to ensure system robustness and user data integrity.
Prepare user documentation and help sections explaining how to register and create a profile, including troubleshooting tips for issues like OTP not received.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to complete a general health assessment using AI-driven tools so that I can understand my current health status and receive personalized health advice.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to initiate and complete a general health assessment
AI adapts questions based on previous answers
Results are summarized and personalized health advice is provided

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface for initiating a general health assessment. Include a start button and instructions. Ensure the interface is accessible and user-friendly. Completion expected within 1 week.

Develop backend logic to handle the initiation and progression of health assessments. This includes session management and state saving to allow users to pause and resume the assessment. Target completion in 2 weeks.

Integrate AI capabilities to adapt subsequent questions based on previous answers provided by the user. Use machine learning models that process user responses and dynamically generate follow-up questions. Aim to complete integration and initial testing within 3 weeks.

Implement functionality to summarize assessment results at the end of the session. This should include a clear presentation of the user’s health status and any notable findings. Completion targeted within 1 week after AI integration.

Create a system to provide personalized health advice based on the assessment results. This system should analyze the results and use a knowledge base to generate relevant health tips and recommendations. Expected to be ready for integration testing in 2 weeks.
Conduct a thorough testing phase for the entire general health assessment feature, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing. Allocate 2 weeks for this testing phase.

Prepare and maintain documentation throughout the development process, detailing the architecture, code, and usage of the health assessment feature. Documentation should be updated in real-time with development.
Setup a feedback mechanism post-assessment to gather user insights and areas for improvement. This should be incorporated into the system within 1 week after the testing phase.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to use voice input to answer health assessment questions so that I can complete assessments more naturally and conveniently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System accurately transcribes spoken responses
Voice input is available for all assessment questions
Responses via voice are captured and processed correctly by the AI

Tasks.Description: Research and select a suitable voice recognition API or library that supports accurate transcription of spoken language into text. Ensure compatibility with the project's technical stack and user demographics. Deadline: 1 week.
Integrate the selected voice recognition API into the existing health assessment platform. Set up initial configurations and ensure it can handle multiple languages if necessary. Deadline: 2 weeks.

Develop a user interface component on the mobile app for voice input. This should include a microphone button that users can tap to start recording their responses. Ensure the design is accessible and easy to use. Deadline: 1 week.
Implement functionality to activate and deactivate voice input during health assessments, allowing users to switch between voice and text input as needed. Deadline: 1 week.

Create a testing protocol to evaluate the accuracy of the voice transcription in various environments and accents. Include a diverse group of test users to cover a wide range of voice patterns. Deadline: 3 weeks.

Develop error handling strategies for cases where voice input is unclear or the API fails to transcribe accurately. Provide users with suggestions to repeat or type their response if transcription fails. Deadline: 1 week.
Integrate the voice input data into the health assessment processing system. Ensure that responses are captured, processed by the AI, and stored securely. Deadline: 2 weeks.
Implement privacy measures to ensure that all voice data is encrypted and handled according to compliance with data protection regulations. Deadline: 1 week.

Conduct a pilot test to assess the functionality, user experience, and accuracy of the voice input feature in real-world conditions. Gather feedback and prepare for final adjustments. Deadline: 2 weeks.
Optimize the system based on feedback and test results to improve transcription accuracy and user interface responsiveness. Deadline: 2 weeks.
Prepare documentation for the voice input feature, including user help guides and technical support material. Deadline: 1 week.
Launch the voice input feature as part of the health assessment tools in the app. Monitor performance and user adoption rates post-launch. Deadline: 1 week after completion of all preparatory tasks.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to perform a mental health screening using AI tools so that I can assess my mental wellbeing and get guidance on seeking further care if necessary.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Complete a mental health assessment
AI flags potential areas of concern
Guidance provided on how to seek further mental health resources

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly interface for the mental health assessment tool, ensuring it is accessible and easy to navigate. This includes creating a clear entry point from the main app dashboard, layout for questions, and submit buttons. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Develop the backend API to handle the submission of mental health assessments. This involves creating endpoints for receiving assessment data and storing it securely in the database. Include error handling for incomplete submissions. Estimated completion time: 5 days.

Integrate AI capabilities to analyze mental health assessment responses in real-time. This includes setting up AI models to identify patterns or signals of mental health concerns based on user responses. Estimated completion time: 7 days.

Implement logic to flag potential areas of concern based on AI analysis. If certain responses indicate a mental health risk, the system should flag these for further action. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Create a resource linkage system that provides users with information and contacts for mental health resources based on the AI's assessment. This involves mapping potential concerns to specific types of support or care. Estimated completion time: 5 days.

Test the mental health assessment tool to ensure it correctly captures user inputs, the AI properly analyzes responses, flags are appropriately set, and guidance is accurately provided. This testing should cover both functional and non-functional requirements. Estimated completion time: 6 days.

Prepare and conduct a user acceptance testing session with a select group of users to gather feedback on the usability of the mental health screening tool and the clarity of the guidance provided. Incorporate feedback into final adjustments. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Deploy the mental health screening tool to the production environment after passing all tests and final approval from the project stakeholders. Ensure that support documentation is updated and teams are briefed on the new features. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Monitor the tool post-launch to collect data on user engagement, effectiveness of AI analysis, and user feedback. Set up a monitoring dashboard to review performance metrics and user satisfaction. Estimated completion time: ongoing first month post-launch.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to evaluate my quality of life through an AI-powered interface so that I can monitor any changes over time and adjust my lifestyle or treatment as needed.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to perform and review a Quality of Life (QoL) assessment
AI analyzes responses to gauge wellbeing
Assessment results are stored and can be tracked over time

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the Quality of Life (QoL) assessment tool, ensuring it is intuitive and user-friendly for patients to perform self-assessments. Include necessary input fields and instructions. Target completion in 2 weeks.

Develop the backend service for handling the input and output of the Quality of Life assessments. This includes APIs to receive assessment data, process it through the AI module, and return results. Plan for completion in 3 weeks.

Integrate an AI module capable of analyzing the Quality of Life assessment responses to gauge the patient's wellbeing. The AI should utilize machine learning models to interpret responses and provide insightful feedback. Expected to be functional and integrated within 4 weeks.

Implement a database schema for storing results of the QoL assessments. Ensure data includes timestamps and can be linked to specific patient profiles for tracking changes over time. Completion targeted within 2 weeks.

Create functionalities in the patient's mobile app for reviewing past Quality of Life assessments. This should include displaying the history of assessments and any noted changes in wellbeing over time. Scheduled for 3 weeks of development.

Conduct a series of user acceptance tests (UAT) to ensure the QoL assessment tool meets the provided acceptance criteria and is user-friendly. Gather feedback and refine the system accordingly. Allocate 2 weeks for UAT and refinements.
Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations and data privacy laws in handling patient data and AI analysis outputs. Review and adjust security measures as needed, aiming to finalize within 1 week.

Prepare and deploy documentation and training materials for patients on how to use the Quality of Life assessment tool. This should be ready for release concurrently with the software launch, planned for 1 week before launch.
Schedule the deployment of the Quality of Life assessment feature, including all necessary system updates and integrations. Final deployment is targeted in 8 weeks from project start.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want the ability to view and edit my past health assessments so that I can update any changes in my health condition.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access past assessment records
Edit responses to past assessments
Ensure edits are securely saved and reflected in the patient history

Tasks.Description: Create a user interface screen for accessing past health assessments, ensuring it is easy to navigate and accessible from the patient's profile menu. This task should be completed within 1 week.

Implement backend API to fetch the list of past health assessments for a specific user, including details necessary for viewing and editing. Data privacy and security measures should be enforced. Task should be completed in 2 weeks.

Develop a feature on the user interface that allows patients to select and view the detailed responses of a specific past assessment. Include functionalities like scroll, search, and filter to enhance user experience. This task should be completed within 1.5 weeks.
Enable editing of responses in past health assessments. Ensure that each input field can be individually edited and provide a 'save' option to submit changes. Complete this task within 2 weeks.

Implement functionality to securely save edits made to past assessments in the database. Use encrypted communication and ensure data integrity during the update operations. Aim to complete this within 1 week.
Create a confirmation system that notifies the user upon successful saving of edits. This could include pop-up messages or email confirmations. Should be implemented within 3 days.

Ensure all changes to health assessments are logged for audit purposes and reflected in the patient's history. Implement logging mechanisms that capture details like date, time, and nature of the edit. Task should be completed in 1 week.

Conduct comprehensive testing to validate the functionality of viewing, editing, and saving health assessments. Include security testing to prevent unauthorized access and data breaches. Testing phase should last for 2 weeks.

Prepare user help documentation and in-app guidance for accessing and editing past health assessments, ensuring clarity and ease of use for all patient demographics. This documentation should be ready in 1 week.

Deploy the new features to the staging environment and conduct a pilot test with a select group of users to gather feedback on the usability and functionality of the edit features in past health assessments. Complete pilot testing in 2 weeks.

E002.Epic Description: Provide a suite of AI-driven tools for patients to conduct self-assessments including general health, mental health, and quality of life assessments, with both written and voice input capabilities.
E002.Story Description: As a patient, I want to access digital pamphlets and interact with an AI chatbot so that I can educate myself about health conditions and receive instant answers to my queries.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Access to digital pamphlets on various health topics
Interact with an AI chatbot for immediate query resolution
Chatbot responses are accurate and contextually relevant

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for accessing digital pamphlets in the mobile app, ensuring it is intuitive and easy to navigate. Include a scrolling feature for various health topics. Completion of designs within 1 week.

Develop the backend API to fetch digital pamphlets from the database. Ensure the API can handle requests efficiently and return the data in a structured format. Include error handling and security features. Development and testing to be completed within 2 weeks.

Implement AI chatbot integration on the mobile app. Use a third-party service like Dialogflow or Microsoft Bot Framework to process natural language and deliver instant responses. Setup should be completed within 1 week, followed by integration testing.

Create a database of FAQs and responses for the AI chatbot to pull from, ensuring the information is accurate and up-to-date with medical standards. Database creation and initial population to be completed within 2 weeks.

Train the AI chatbot using machine learning techniques to improve the accuracy and relevance of the responses over time. Begin with a training dataset and plan to retrain the model every 3 months based on new data and user interactions.

Develop a user feedback system to gather user experiences and chatbot performance data. Include options for rating the usefulness of the chatbot responses and providing textual feedback. Implementation should be completed within 1 week.

Perform end-to-end testing of the digital pamphlet access and AI chatbot functionalities. This includes testing user interface interactions, API reliability, chatbot response accuracy, and overall system performance. Allocate 2 weeks for thorough testing.

Deploy the digital pamphlet and AI chatbot features to the staging environment for beta testing. Gather user feedback to make necessary adjustments before final release. Plan for a 1-week beta test period followed by deployment adjustments.

Prepare and conduct training sessions for the support team on managing the AI chatbot and updating the digital pamphlet content, ensuring they can handle common issues and update information as needed. Schedule training sessions 1 week before the app release.

Launch the feature publicly with an official release announcement. Include detailed documentation on how to use the new features. Plan the launch event for 1 week after completing all testing and adjustments.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to create and edit my profile so that I can keep my personal and health information up to date.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can successfully register using their mobile number and OTP.
Patients can update their profiles with information like age, gender, phone number, and profile picture.
Patients can link their profiles with their chosen hospital using a secure code.
Ensure the profile updating process is secure and compliant with privacy regulations.

Tasks.Description: Design a registration form interface on the mobile app that includes input fields for mobile number and OTP verification. Ensure the design is user-friendly and accessible.
Implement backend logic to send an OTP to a user-specified mobile number. Use a reliable third-party service for SMS delivery and ensure it is capable of handling the expected volume of SMS messages.
Develop a secure method for OTP verification that validates the OTP entered by the user against the server-stored value, with a timeout feature to ensure security.

Create a user interface for profile editing that allows patients to update personal information such as age, gender, phone number, and profile picture. Include appropriate input validations to ensure data integrity.
Implement functionality to save updated profile data to the backend. Use secure APIs and ensure that all data transmissions are encrypted.

Develop a feature in the patient profile section for linking to a hospital using a secure code provided by the hospital. This should include a backend service to verify the code with the hospital’s database securely.
Implement comprehensive security checks and data validation across all endpoints involved in the registration, profile updating, and hospital linking processes to adhere to privacy regulations.
Conduct a security audit to ensure that the data handling and storage procedures comply with relevant privacy laws and best practices, particularly those concerning health information.
Test the registration and profile update processes extensively. Include tests for normal operation, boundary conditions, and potential security breaches.
Prepare documentation for the registration and profile management features, detailing the workflow, data fields, security measures, and any third-party services used.
Deploy the new registration and profile management features to a staging environment to perform integration testing with other parts of the app, ensuring compatibility and smooth operation.
Plan and conduct a user acceptance testing (UAT) phase with real users to gather feedback on the usability and functionality of the registration and profile updating features.
Review feedback from UAT, make necessary adjustments, and prepare for final deployment, ensuring all features are polished and perform as expected under load.
Schedule and execute deployment to the production environment, followed by a post-deployment monitoring phase to ensure system stability and performance.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to input health assessment data using AI-powered forms so that I can efficiently update my health information.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can initiate different health assessments via the app.
AI assists in transcribing responses from speech to text where applicable.
The system provides an intuitive UI for entering health data.
Patients can review and confirm the accuracy of the AI-transcribed information before submission.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface (UI) for initiating health assessments in the patient app. The UI should have clear and accessible options for starting various types of health assessments.

Integrate AI-powered speech-to-text capabilities to transcribe patient responses during health assessments. Ensure the AI module can handle medical terminology and patient-specific language nuances effectively.

Develop and test the user interface for entering health data, ensuring it is intuitive and user-friendly. Include input fields, dropdowns, and other components that accommodate all necessary health data types.

Implement functionality within the app to allow patients to review the AI-transcribed data before final submission. Provide options for editing and confirming accuracy, ensuring the patient's ability to make corrections if needed.

Conduct usability testing with real users to validate the intuitiveness of the health data entry UI and the effectiveness of the speech-to-text transcription. Gather feedback and iterate on the design to improve the user experience.

Ensure that all personal and health data entered and transcribed through the app is securely handled according to HIPAA regulations. Implement encryption for data in transit and at rest, and provide secure access controls.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view and edit my previously entered health assessments so that I can correct or update my health data.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can view a list of all past assessments.
Patients can select a specific assessment to view detailed responses.
Patients can edit responses in their assessments.
Ensure edits are saved correctly and the original data can be audited for changes.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a user interface for viewing a list of all past health assessments. This interface should include sortable columns for dates and types of assessments. Ensure the UI is accessible and responsive. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Develop backend functionality to fetch and send a list of all past health assessments from the database to the frontend. Include caching strategies to optimize response times and reduce server load. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Create detailed assessment view functionality. When a patient selects an assessment from the list, this should pull detailed data from the backend and display it in a detailed view format on the frontend. Include fields shown in the original assessment form. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Implement edit functionality for health assessments. Patients should be able to modify their responses in this detailed view. Ensure fields are validated both on the client and server sides to maintain data integrity. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Ensure all edits are saved correctly by implementing a robust backend method to handle updates. This method should validate data consistency, prevent SQL injection, and return a success or error message to the frontend. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Implement an audit trail system to log changes made to health assessments. Each entry should include the user ID, timestamp, nature of the edit, and previous data state. This log should be immutable and stored securely. Estimated completion time: 5 days.

Conduct comprehensive unit testing for both frontend and backend functionalities to ensure all new features work as expected and meet the acceptance criteria. Include tests for security and performance. Estimated completion time: 3 days.
Plan and execute integration testing to verify that the new functionalities interact properly with existing features and the entire application remains stable. Estimated completion time: 2 days.
Document all code changes, API endpoints, and user instructions. Ensure documentation is clear and accessible to support both the maintenance team and end-users. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Deploy the new features in a staging environment for real-world testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments before final deployment. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to complete AI-powered mental health assessments so that I can monitor my mental health and get recommendations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The app provides a mental health assessment module powered by AI.
Patients can answer questions related to their mental health, with AI analyzing responses.
The system provides feedback or suggestions based on AI analysis.
Ensure the AI model complies with health standards for mental health assessments.

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the mental health assessment module, ensuring it is user-friendly and accessible within the app. Include elements to start the assessment, display questions, and show AI-generated feedback. (Measurable: UI mockups reviewed and approved by the design team, Achievable: 2 weeks for initial designs and revisions, Relevant: Aligns with the need for a module to administer AI-powered assessments)

Develop the backend service to handle mental health assessment operations, including storing questions and recording responses. (Measurable: Fully functional service capable of storing and retrieving data, Achievable: 4 weeks for development and testing, Relevant: Essential for capturing and analyzing patient responses)

Integrate artificial intelligence capabilities to analyze patient responses and generate insights on their mental health status. Use an existing AI service or develop a custom solution as per compliance needs. (Measurable: AI provides correct analysis on test data, Achievable: 6 weeks including integration and testing, Relevant: Directly relates to generating AI-powered feedback)

Implement feedback mechanisms in the app where patients receive suggestions or mental health advice based on the AI's analysis of their assessment results. (Measurable: Feedback function tested with 95% accuracy, Achievable: 3 weeks for implementation and testing, Relevant: Addresses the criteria of providing feedback based on AI analysis)

Conduct a compliance check to ensure the mental health assessment AI model adheres to health standards and regulations. (Measurable: Receive compliance certification, Achievable: 2 weeks for the compliance team to review and certify, Relevant: Ensures the AI model is safe and meets regulatory standards)

Prepare and conduct a training session for the support team on how to assist patients in using the new mental health assessment feature, including troubleshooting common issues. (Measurable: Training completed, and support readiness assessed through a quiz, Achievable: 1 week for preparation and training session, Relevant: Supports patient engagement with the new feature)

Plan and execute a beta testing phase involving a select group of patients to gather early feedback on the usability and efficacy of the mental health assessment tool. (Measurable: Collect and review feedback from at least 30 beta testers, Achievable: 3 weeks including recruitment, testing, and review, Relevant: Validates the assessment tool's performance and user satisfaction before full launch)

Document the development process and create a user manual for the mental health assessment feature, detailing how to access and interpret the assessment results. (Measurable: Documentation reviewed and approved by project stakeholders, Achievable: 2 weeks for drafting and revisions, Relevant: Provides end-users with necessary guidance on using the feature)

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to securely log out of the healthcare app so that I can ensure my data is protected from unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Logout functionality is easily accessible from anywhere in the app.
Upon logging out, ensure all sessions are terminated securely.
Ensure that after logout, re-authentication is required to access the patient profile.

Tasks.Description: Design a logout button that is prominently accessible from the main navigation or menu of the app, ensuring visibility across all app screens. This should be completed by a UI/UX designer within 3 days.

Implement the logout functionality on the client side by connecting the logout button to the user authentication service, which should initiate session termination. This task should be completed by a front-end developer within 2 days.
Develop backend API to handle logout requests that will invalidate the current session token and clear any authentication cookies. The backend developer should complete this within 2 days.

Ensure all user session data is cleared from the device upon logout to prevent unauthorized access. This includes cached data and any stored tokens. The mobile development team should address this within 2 days.

Set up a re-authentication process that requires users to log in again after they have logged out. Modify the authentication flow to ensure it redirects to the login screen post-logout. A backend developer should set this up in 1 day.
Perform comprehensive testing of the logout functionality to ensure it works as expected across different devices and user scenarios. Quality assurance should complete testing within 3 days.

Create documentation for the logout feature detailing the design decisions, code implementations, and testing scenarios to maintain a record for future reference. The technical writer should prepare this document within 2 days.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to be able to send feedback or request support so that I can communicate any issues or suggestions to improve the app.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can access a feedback form from the app.
Patients can categorize their feedback (e.g., bug report, feature request, general feedback).
Submitted feedback is received by the admin and is actionable.
Ensure patient privacy is maintained in feedback submissions.

Tasks.Description: Design a user-friendly feedback form interface within the app that includes fields for categorizing feedback (e.g., bug report, feature request, general feedback), and a submission button. Ensure the design complies with accessibility standards. Estimated time: 8 hours.

Develop the backend API to handle the submission of feedback forms, including storage and categorization of the feedback. This task includes creating database schemas for storing feedback and ensuring robust security measures to protect patient data. Estimated time: 16 hours.
Implement front-end functionality for the feedback form using React Native or a similar framework. This includes data binding, form validation, and handling submissions. Estimated time: 12 hours.
Integrate the feedback form with the backend API, ensuring data is transmitted securely using HTTPS and other security protocols. Estimated time: 6 hours.

Set up administrative alerts in the backend to notify system admins when new feedback is submitted, categorizing the urgency based on the feedback type (bug reports being high priority). Estimated time: 4 hours.

Test the feedback submission process thoroughly with unit tests for backend logic and integration tests that simulate user interaction on the front end. Ensure that all categories of feedback can be submitted and received properly. Estimated time: 10 hours.

Implement privacy measures to ensure that feedback submissions are anonymized before storage or provide clear disclaimers if personal information is included. Compliance checks with GDPR or HIPAA should be conducted. Estimated time: 5 hours.

Develop a feature for admins to easily access and act on feedback within the admin panel, including filtering options based on category and status (new, in progress, resolved). Estimated time: 8 hours.
Deploy changes to a staging environment for live testing with a select group of users to gather initial feedback on the usability and functionality of the feedback form. Estimated time: 3 hours.
Conduct a security audit of the feedback handling process to ensure that there are no vulnerabilities through which patient data can be accessed or compromised. Estimated time: 8 hours.
Prepare documentation for system administrators and users on how to use the new feedback form, including guidelines on privacy and data security. Estimated time: 4 hours.

Plan and execute a roll-out of the feedback mechanism to all users, including an announcement and educational materials on how to use the feature effectively. Monitor user adoption and gather initial impressions for ongoing improvements. Estimated time: 8 hours.

E003.Epic Description: Allow patients to view, edit, and manage their health assessment data and medical history securely within the app.
E003.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to use a QR code to share my assessment data with doctors so that my health information can be easily accessed during consultations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients can generate a QR code within the app that encapsulates their health data.
QR codes are generated in a secure manner, ensuring data privacy.
Doctors can scan the QR code to access the patient's data quickly.

Tasks.Description: Design a QR code generation feature interface within the app for patients to generate QR codes of their health data. Ensure the interface is user-friendly and accessible within the patient's health data section. Duration: 3 days.

Develop the backend logic to encapsulate patient's health data into a QR code. This involves selecting the relevant health data fields, encoding them, and generating the QR code image. Use secure encoding methods to protect data privacy. Duration: 5 days.

Implement encryption for the data encapsulated within the QR code to ensure its security. Choose an industry-standard encryption algorithm and integrate it into the QR code generation process. Duration: 4 days.

Create a testing protocol to ensure that the encrypted QR codes are generated correctly and can be read accurately by scanning. This should include tests for data integrity and decryption. Duration: 3 days.
Develop a feature for doctors within their app version to scan and decrypt patient QR codes. Ensure compatibility and quick data access post-scan. Duration: 5 days.
Conduct a security audit to review the QR code generation and scanning functionality to ensure there are no vulnerabilities in data handling and encryption processes. Duration: 2 days.
Prepare and conduct a user training session for patients on how to generate and share their health data QR codes. Include best practices for privacy and data sharing. Duration: 2 days.

Deploy the QR code functionality to a staging environment for integration testing with the existing patient app infrastructure to ensure system compatibility and performance under load. Duration: 3 days.
Gather feedback from a patient focus group on the usability of the QR code generation feature and the clarity of the training provided. Use feedback to make necessary adjustments. Duration: 3 days.

Release the QR code sharing feature to production after final approval and ensure that support documentation is updated to include instructions for both patients and doctors on using the new feature. Duration: 2 days.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want the AI chatbot to access my health profile so that I can receive personalized answers based on my medical history.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The chatbot must securely access patient health data.
Patients receive responses tailored to their medical history.
Responses must be generated within a few seconds of the query.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure API for the AI chatbot to access patient health data, ensuring it uses authentication and encryption mechanisms. This task should be completed within two weeks.

Configure the AI chatbot to fetch relevant patient data based on the query context and securely access the patient's health profile. Include error handling and logging capabilities. Estimated completion time is three weeks.

Develop a personalized response generation logic for the AI chatbot that uses patient health data to tailor responses. This logic must handle various health data parameters and conditions. The development and initial testing should be done within four weeks.

Implement a response timing mechanism to ensure that chatbot responses are generated and delivered within a few seconds. This includes optimizing query handling and server response times. Task should be completed in one week.

Conduct a security audit of the AI chatbot interactions with the patient health data API to verify compliance with healthcare data protection regulations. The audit should be performed over one week, after the development tasks are completed.

Perform comprehensive testing of the AI chatbot, focusing on its ability to securely access health data, generate personalized responses, and adhere to response time requirements. Schedule two weeks for testing, including unit, integration, and performance tests.

Prepare documentation for the AI chatbot functionality that covers setup, configuration, and operational guidelines, with a focus on security practices and data handling. The documentation should be ready for review within one week after functionality is confirmed.

Organize a training session for the support team on the new AI chatbot features, particularly focusing on the security aspects and the data access process. The session should be scheduled for one day and occur after the completion of all development and testing tasks.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to ask general health questions and receive accurate information so that I can better understand health conditions without a doctor's visit.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The chatbot should provide medically accurate information.
The content must be sourced from reliable health databases or literature.
The chatbot should clarify that it doesn't replace professional medical advice.

Tasks.Description: Research and select a reliable health database or literature sources that will be used to feed information to the AI chatbot, ensuring they are current and widely recognized in the medical community. Completion due in 1 week.

Develop algorithms for the AI chatbot to fetch relevant information from the selected databases or literature sources based on user queries. Include error handling and fallback mechanisms. Task to be completed within 3 weeks.

Integrate the AI chatbot with the selected medical databases or literature sources using API or direct database access, with a focus on data security and privacy compliance. Integration to be tested and completed by the end of 4 weeks.

Program the AI chatbot to provide responses that clearly state the information is for general understanding and does not replace professional medical advice. Include this disclaimer in all applicable responses. This task should be completed in 2 weeks.
Implement functionality in the AI chatbot to maintain logs of the sources used for each piece of information provided, to ensure traceability and accountability. Complete this task within 3 weeks.

Conduct a series of tests to validate the accuracy of the information provided by the AI chatbot, involving medical professionals to ensure the responses are correct and safe. Testing phase to last 3 weeks.
Develop a user feedback system for the AI chatbot where users can rate the helpfulness of the information provided and submit corrections or suggestions. Implement this feature over 4 weeks.

Set up a continuous update mechanism for the chatbot's knowledge base, ensuring the information remains current with ongoing medical research and findings. Plan for monthly review cycles with initial setup completed in 2 weeks.

Prepare and deliver training sessions for the support team on managing and maintaining the AI chatbot, highlighting procedures for updating the information source and handling user feedback. Schedule training within 5 weeks from project start.

Create documentation detailing the chatbot’s data sources, algorithms, integration methods, and operation protocols to assist with future maintenance and audits. Documentation to be completed within 6 weeks.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to inquire about various treatment options for specific conditions so that I can be informed about possible treatments before consulting with a healthcare professional.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Treatment information provided must be up-to-date and based on the latest medical guidelines.
The system should ask patients to confirm the condition they are inquiring about to ensure relevance.
Provide links or references to detailed sources when available.

Tasks.Description: Research and integrate a medical database or API that includes up-to-date treatment options based on the latest medical guidelines. Set a deadline for selection and integration within four weeks.

Design and implement a user interface component within the chatbot where patients can specify the medical condition they are inquiring about. Include autocomplete functionality to assist with spelling and recognition of medical terms. Complete this task within two weeks.

Develop a system within the chatbot to verify the patient's input and confirm the condition they are inquiring about before providing treatment options. This validation should use existing medical data to ensure accuracy and relevance. Schedule to finalize this feature in three weeks.

Create functionality in the chatbot to link treatment information to official medical resources or guidelines. This involves programming the chatbot to fetch and display URLs or references dynamically based on the treatment data provided. Aim to complete this in three weeks.

Test the chatbot to ensure that the treatment information provided is accurate, up-to-date, and correctly linked to the medical condition specified by the user. Include unit tests and user acceptance tests to be completed over two weeks.

Plan and execute a session to train the support team on the new chatbot features, focusing on how to guide users in using the chatbot to inquire about treatment options effectively. Arrange this training session to occur a week before the scheduled release.

Set up continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the deployment of chatbot updates, ensuring that treatment information can be updated swiftly as new medical guidelines are published. This should be ready in four weeks.

Organize a feedback mechanism for users to report inaccuracies or outdated information in the treatment options provided by the chatbot. Implement this feature within one week after the initial deployment.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to ask about medications and receive details about dosages, side effects, and interactions so that I can safely manage my prescriptions.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The chatbot must provide information from a verified pharmaceutical database.
Include a disclaimer about consulting with a healthcare provider for personal medical advice.
Allow the user to specify the medication name accurately using text input.

Tasks.Description: Research and select a verified pharmaceutical database that provides comprehensive medication information including dosages, side effects, and interactions.
Develop a secure API integration with the selected pharmaceutical database to retrieve medication information.
Implement functionality in the AI chatbot to process user input for medication names and match it with database entries for accurate retrieval of medication information.

Design and integrate a disclaimer message in the chatbot interface that advises users to consult with a healthcare provider for personal medical advice. Ensure the disclaimer is prominently displayed whenever medication information is provided.

Create a user interface input field within the chatbot that allows users to type the name of the medication they wish to inquire about. Include autocomplete features to assist with entering medication names accurately.
Conduct usability testing to ensure that the chatbot allows users to easily specify medication names and that the information retrieved is presented in a clear and understandable manner.
Implement error handling in the chatbot to manage instances when the medication name does not match database entries or when the API fails to retrieve data.

Deploy the updated AI chatbot to a test environment and perform integration testing to verify that the chatbot correctly interacts with the pharmaceutical database and handles user queries as expected.
Prepare documentation for the chatbot functionality that explains how to query medication information and the limitations of the data provided.
Schedule a training session for the support team on the new chatbot functionality to ensure they can assist users with any queries related to medication information.
Launch the chatbot feature in a controlled rollout to monitor its performance and gather initial feedback from users on the medication information functionality.
Analyze user feedback and usage data of the chatbot medication inquiry feature to identify any areas for improvement or additional user needs.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to query the AI chatbot about hospital policies and procedures so that I can understand what to expect during hospital visits.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Chatbot responses must reflect the most current policies and procedures.
Information should include visiting hours, admission processes, and patient services.
Responses should be provided in an easy-to-understand format.

Tasks.Description: Gather the most current hospital policies and procedures data including visiting hours, admission processes, and patient services from each associated hospital's administrative team. Set a deadline for data collection within 1 week to ensure timely update in the system.

Design and implement a database schema to store hospital policies and procedures information. Ensure the design supports quick retrieval and is scalable to accommodate data from multiple hospitals. Complete the schema design within 3 days of receiving hospital data.

Develop an API that can fetch the most current policies and procedures from the database. Include endpoints to retrieve specific details such as visiting hours, admission processes, and patient services. Aim to complete the API development within 5 days from the completion of database schema.

Integrate the newly developed API with the AI chatbot system to enable real-time fetching of hospital policies and procedures data when queried by users. Set the integration and initial testing phase to be completed within 2 days post API development.

Implement natural language processing (NLP) capabilities to the AI Chatbot for understanding and processing user queries related to hospital policies and procedures. This task should be geared towards recognizing and responding to relevant keywords and phrases, with a completion goal within 7 days.

Create a content management system (CMS) interface where hospital administrators can update their policies and procedures information as changes occur. This interface should be user-friendly and require minimal training. Schedule the completion of this interface within 10 days from the start.

Develop a training program for hospital administrators to use the CMS effectively. Training materials should include video tutorials and written guides. Plan to have the training resources ready within 5 days after the CMS deployment.

Conduct user acceptance testing with a focus group of patients to ensure the AI chatbot provides information in an easy-to-understand format. Collect feedback and make necessary adjustments over a period of 5 days.

Set up a continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline for automated updates and testing of the AI chatbot system whenever changes are made in the database or the API. Aim to have the CI/CD pipeline operational within 7 days.

Monitor and evaluate the AI chatbot's performance for a month to collect data on user interactions and satisfaction levels, making adjustments based on real user feedback to ensure the chatbot's responses remain relevant and easily understandable.

E004.Epic Description: Incorporate an AI chatbot that provides patients with information and answers queries about their condition, treatment options, and general health questions.
E004.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to be able to provide feedback on the information provided by the AI chatbot so that I can report inaccuracies or excellent service.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Provide an easy-to-use feedback form linked to each chatbot response.
Feedback should be categorized as positive, negative, or report an inaccuracy.
The system should acknowledge receipt of feedback immediately.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the feedback form that will be accessible directly from each AI chatbot response. Include fields for categorizing feedback as positive, negative, or reporting an inaccuracy. Ensure the form is intuitive and easy to use. Completion of the UI design should be done within 1 week.

Develop the front-end functionality for the feedback form, enabling users to submit their feedback directly from the chatbot interface. This should include form validation to ensure all required fields are filled out before submission. Aim to complete this task within 2 weeks.

Implement backend services to handle the reception of feedback from the form. This includes storing feedback in the database and categorizing it according to its nature (positive, negative, inaccuracy). The backend should be robust enough to handle multiple feedback submissions simultaneously. Completion expected within 3 weeks.

Create an automated system to send immediate acknowledgment notifications to users once their feedback is received. This should include a thank-you message or confirmation alert. This task should be implemented and tested within 1 week.

Integrate the feedback form with the AI chatbot responses ensuring that the form can be accessed easily whenever a user interacts with the chatbot. Include user testing to validate the integration works seamlessly. Scheduled completion within 2 weeks.

Conduct comprehensive testing including unit, integration, and user acceptance tests to ensure the feedback mechanism works as expected across different devices and platforms. Allocate 2 weeks for thorough testing and allow for bug fixing.

Prepare and update documentation on how to use the feedback system for both internal use (development and support teams) and external users (help documentation). Completion of documentation is expected within 1 week after final testing.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to browse through a list of digital pamphlets and educational materials, so that I can learn about different health conditions and treatments.
Story Acceptance Criteria: List of digital pamphlets is accessible and scrollable.
Each pamphlet has a clear title and short description.
The app should load the initial list within 3 seconds of accessing the feature.
Pamphlets are categorized by health condition for easy browsing.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI layout for the digital pamphlets list feature, ensuring it supports accessibility and scrollability.
Implement a front-end component for displaying the list of digital pamphlets, incorporating infinite scroll to handle large sets of data efficiently.
Develop a backend API to fetch digital pamphlets data, including titles and short descriptions from the database.
Optimize the performance of the pamphlet list loading to ensure the initial content loads within 3 seconds.
Categorize digital pamphlets by health conditions in the database to facilitate easier browsing and access in the UI.
Integrate a search and filter functionality in the UI to allow users to easily find pamphlets by category or keywords.
Implement caching strategies both on the client-side and server-side to enhance the speed of content delivery.
Conduct user testing to ensure the digital pamphlets list is easy to navigate, understand, and use on various devices.
Set up monitoring and logging tools to assess the load time of the pamphlets list and identify any performance bottlenecks.
Review and ensure compliance with accessibility standards to make the feature usable for all patients, including those with disabilities.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view detailed information about a specific pamphlet, so that I can understand more about the health topic it covers.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Detailed view includes full content of the pamphlet.
Images and charts within the pamphlet are properly formatted and visible.
Users can return to the main list from the detailed view with a single action.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI layout for the detailed view of a pamphlet that includes sections for full content, images, and charts. Ensure that the design is responsive and visually appealing. Deadline: 2 days from now.

Implement the frontend interface for the pamphlet's detailed view according to the UI design, using HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Ensure that text, images, and charts are properly formatted and align with design specifications. Deadline: 4 days from now.

Develop backend API to retrieve the full content of the pamphlet, including text, images, and chart data from the database. Ensure API security with appropriate authentication and data validation. Deadline: 3 days from now.

Integrate the frontend detailed view with the backend API to dynamically display the content of the pamphlets. Test for data loading times and correct rendering of content. Deadline: 2 days after backend completion.

Implement a 'Back to List' button on the detailed view page that allows users to easily navigate back to the main list of pamphlets. Ensure the button is prominently placed and tested for functionality. Deadline: 1 day after frontend integration.

Conduct a comprehensive QA session to ensure that all elements in the detailed view are accessible, properly formatted, and function correctly across different devices and browsers. Deadline: 2 days after all implementations are completed.

Prepare user documentation and help sections that explain how to navigate the detailed view of the pamphlets. Include troubleshooting tips for common issues users might encounter. Deadline: 1 day after QA completion.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to download digital pamphlets to my device, so that I can read them offline or share them with family and friends.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Download option is clearly visible on the pamphlet detail page.
Pamphlet is saved to the device's local storage.
Users receive a confirmation message once download is successful.
Downloaded pamphlet maintains its formatting and content integrity.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for the pamphlet detail page that includes a clearly visible 'Download' button. This task should be completed by the UX/UI team by the end of the week.

Implement the functionality to save the pamphlet to the device's local storage when the 'Download' button is clicked. This involves file handling operations and should be handled by a mobile application developer within 3 days.

Develop a confirmation message popup or notification that appears once the pamphlet download is successful. This task should include creating a small, reusable component by the front-end team, to be completed within 2 days.

Ensure that the downloaded pamphlet maintains its formatting and content integrity. This requires testing various formats across different devices, which should be led by the QA team and completed within 1 week.
Create a test plan to ensure that the download functionality works under different network conditions and device storage statuses. The QA team should execute this in a span of 4 days.
Set up monitoring and logging for the download transactions to help troubleshoot any issues users encounter during the download process. The backend team should implement this within 3 days.

Review app permissions related to storage access to ensure compliance with mobile operating system guidelines. This should be reviewed by a compliance officer and adjusted by developers within 5 days.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to search for pamphlets by keywords, so that I can quickly find materials relevant to my specific health concerns.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Search bar is accessible from the main pamphlet list screen.
Results update in real-time as the user types.
Search results display pamphlets that contain the search keywords in the title or description.
No results found message is displayed if there are no matches.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a UI component for a search bar on the main pamphlet list screen. This task includes creating a mockup, getting it approved by the UI/UX team, and coding the frontend component. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Develop the backend API to handle search queries for pamphlets. This should support partial text search and return results in real-time as the user types. Implement indexing on the pamphlet title and description fields to improve search performance. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Integrate the search bar UI with the backend search API. This involves setting up the AJAX calls to fetch data dynamically as input is received and updating the UI without needing to reload the page. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Implement logic to display search results dynamically as the user types in the search bar. This includes handling and rendering data returned from the backend API. Ensure that the UI updates immediately with the relevant pamphlet titles and descriptions. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Create a 'No results found' message UI component that gets displayed when the search results are empty. This component should be clear and user-friendly, informing users that no pamphlets match their search criteria. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

Conduct thorough testing on the search functionality to ensure that it meets all acceptance criteria: accessibility from the main screen, real-time updates, accurate display of results, and proper handling when no results are found. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to rate and review the pamphlets I read, so that I can provide feedback and help other patients gauge the usefulness of the materials.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Rating and review option available on each pamphlet’s detail page.
Users can submit a star rating from 1 to 5.
Users can write a text review up to 500 characters.
Submitted ratings and reviews are immediately visible to the user and saved to their profile.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component on the pamphlet detail page for rating and review submission, including a star rating system (1-5 stars) and a text box for reviews up to 500 characters. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Implement front-end functionality for the rating and review system using React/Angular to handle user interactions and local state management for immediate UI updates. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Develop API endpoints to handle the submission of ratings and reviews. This includes POST endpoints for submitting new ratings and reviews and GET endpoints to retrieve existing ones. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Integrate the front-end components with the backend API to ensure that user submissions for ratings and reviews are processed and stored in the database. Use Axios or Fetch API for HTTP requests. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Write unit tests for both front-end and back-end components to verify that the rating and review system works as expected, including input validation and API response handling. Use Jest for frontend and Mocha for backend. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Implement functionality to display submitted ratings and reviews immediately on the user interface after submission, ensuring real-time feedback is visible to users. Include error handling for failed submissions. Estimated completion: 1 day.

Configure database schema to store user ratings and reviews, ensuring data integrity with appropriate fields for user ID, pamphlet ID, rating, review text, and timestamps. Estimated completion: 1 day.
Develop a system to aggregate and display average ratings on each pamphlet’s detail page, updating dynamically as new reviews are added. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Ensure compliance with data privacy laws by implementing proper security measures on the handling and storing of user feedback. Include user authentication to verify identity before submission. Estimated completion: 1 day.

Perform integration testing to ensure that the new rating and review system works seamlessly with existing features like user authentication, pamphlet viewing, and downloading. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Prepare a change management plan for deploying the rating and review system, including rollback steps, monitoring strategies, and user communication. Estimated completion: 1 day.

E005.Epic Description: Enable patients to access and download digital pamphlets and educational materials through the app, enhancing their knowledge and understanding of health conditions.
E005.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to access a FAQ section related to each pamphlet, so that I can quickly find answers to common questions regarding the health topics covered.
Story Acceptance Criteria: FAQ section is available at the bottom of each pamphlet detail page.
FAQs are presented in a collapsible format to enhance readability.
Each FAQ can be expanded or collapsed with a single tap.
The most common questions are listed first.

Tasks.Description: Design the UI layout for the FAQ section at the bottom of each pamphlet detail page, ensuring it is visible and accessible. Include placeholders for collapsible FAQ items. (Time-bound: 2 days)

Implement the collapsible functionality for FAQ items using JavaScript or a suitable framework to enable expand/collapse actions with a single tap. Ensure this is tested across different device types for responsiveness and ease of use. (Time-bound: 3 days)

Develop the backend service to fetch and serve FAQ content, ensuring data is structured to support sorting with the most common questions listed first. This service must handle requests efficiently and securely. (Time-bound: 4 days)

Integrate the FAQ display in the app with the newly developed backend service, ensuring FAQs are loaded dynamically at the bottom of each pamphlet detail page. Include error handling for failed data fetching. (Time-bound: 2 days)

Conduct usability testing for the FAQ section to ensure that the collapsible elements and overall readability meet the user experience standards. Gather feedback and make necessary adjustments. (Time-bound: 3 days)

Prepare and update the app documentation to include details about the FAQ section functionality, its usage, and troubleshooting common issues. Ensure documentation is clear and easy to understand. (Time-bound: 1 day)

E006.Epic Description: Facilitate secure sharing of patient health data with doctors through QR codes, enhancing the efficiency of medical consultations and patient data portability.
E006.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to generate a QR code that securely encapsulates my health data, so that I can easily share it with doctors during medical consultations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The QR code generation feature must be easily accessible in the patient app interface.
The generated QR code should encrypt the patient data to ensure security.
Doctors should be able to scan the QR code using their app and immediately access the patient's health data.
The patient must be able to regenerate a QR code for each new consultation for enhanced security.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface element on the patient app homepage for easy access to the QR code generation feature. Ensure this design is intuitive and clearly labeled, to be completed within 3 days.
Implement end-to-end encryption for the QR code data payload. Use a secure algorithm suitable for health data, such as AES-256. Complete the implementation and testing within 5 days.
Develop functionality in the patient app to generate a QR code based on the encrypted health data. Ensure the QR code generation process is fast and secure, to be completed within 4 days.

Create an API in the doctor's app to scan and decrypt the QR code. Ensure compatibility with common mobile device cameras and test for accuracy in various lighting conditions, to be finished within 5 days.

Ensure that the patient can regenerate a QR code for each new consultation by adding a 'Regenerate QR Code' button in the app. Include logic to invalidate the old QR code when a new one is generated, task to be done within 2 days.

Conduct end-to-end testing of the QR code generation and scanning feature to confirm that doctors can access the health data immediately after scanning. Schedule user acceptance testing within 7 days.

Optimize the QR code regeneration feature to ensure enhanced security, making sure each new QR code is usable for only one consultation. This should include backend validation mechanisms, to be completed within 3 days.
Prepare documentation for the QR code feature, detailing the generation, encryption, and scanning processes for both patient and doctor side applications. Complete documentation within 4 days.

Implement logging and monitoring for the QR code generation and scanning activities to track usage statistics and potential security issues. Set up the monitoring tools and define alert criteria within 4 days.

E006.Epic Description: Facilitate secure sharing of patient health data with doctors through QR codes, enhancing the efficiency of medical consultations and patient data portability.
E006.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to link my profile with a hospital by scanning a QR code, so that my health data and hospital records are synchronized for better healthcare management.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients must be able to scan a QR code provided by the hospital to link their profiles.
Upon successful linking, the patient’s app should display confirmation of the hospital linkage.
The system must ensure that all patient data remains secure and only shareable with the linked hospital’s system.
The patient should have the ability to unlink from the hospital via the app, requiring re-authentication.

Tasks.Description: Develop a QR code scanning feature within the patient mobile app to facilitate the linking of patient profiles with hospital systems. Ensure the scanner is compatible with standard QR code formats used by hospitals.
Implement a secure backend API that receives the QR code data from the patient app, verifies it against hospital records, and establishes a link if verified.
Create a user interface update that confirms the successful linking of a patient's profile to a hospital once the QR code has been verified and the backend linkage is complete.
Enhance data security by implementing encryption for all data transmitted between the patient app and the hospital system during the QR code linkage process.
Develop functionality within the patient app that allows a patient to unlink their profile from a hospital. This should include a re-authentication process to ensure that the request is legitimate.
Set up automated tests to validate the QR code scanning and linking process, including edge cases where QR codes are invalid or the hospital ID does not match.
Conduct a security audit to ensure that the linkage via QR code does not expose patient data to unauthorized access or breaches.
Provide a clear and intuitive user interface for patients to manage their linked hospital records, including the ability to view the current linked hospital and an option to unlink.
Document the QR code linking process and provide in-app help or tutorials for patients on how to use the QR code feature to link or unlink their profiles with hospitals.

E006.Epic Description: Facilitate secure sharing of patient health data with doctors through QR codes, enhancing the efficiency of medical consultations and patient data portability.
E006.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to view a history of all the doctors and hospitals with whom I have shared my health data via QR code, so that I can keep track of who has accessed my information.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The app must provide a dedicated section for viewing the history of shared data.
The history should include the name of the doctor or hospital and the date of access.
Patients should be able to remove old entries from their shared data history.
The feature should be protected by additional security measures within the app to prevent unauthorized access.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for viewing the history of shared health data. The interface should include sections for the names of the doctors or hospitals and the dates of access. Estimated design time: 3 days.

Implement the backend logic to retrieve and display the history of shared data from the database. This includes fetching names of doctors or hospitals and the dates they accessed the patient’s data. Estimated development time: 5 days.

Develop front-end functionality for the new user interface that allows patients to view the shared data history. This task will involve connecting the front-end with the backend services to fetch and display the data. Estimated development time: 4 days.

Implement the functionality to allow patients to remove old entries from their shared data history. This includes front-end options to delete specific entries and backend logic to remove these entries from the database securely. Estimated development time: 4 days.

Enhance app security for the section that displays shared data history. Implement additional authentication checks to ensure only the authorised patient can access their data history. Consider using encryption or secure access tokens. Estimated implementation time: 3 days.

Conduct a security audit of the new features to ensure data protection standards are met and that there are no vulnerabilities in accessing the shared data history. Estimated time for security audit: 2 days.

Integrate and test the new functionality with the existing patient app to ensure compatibility and stability of the application. This includes end-to-end testing and user acceptance testing. Estimated testing phase: 4 days.

Prepare documentation for the new data history viewing feature, detailing how patients can access, view, and manage their shared health data history. Include security measures and instructions for deleting history entries. Estimated documentation time: 2 days.

Deploy the new features to the staging environment for a pilot test with a select group of users to gather feedback and ensure the features meet user needs before full deployment. Estimated pilot test duration: 5 days.

Review feedback from pilot testing, make necessary adjustments to the feature based on user input, and finalize the feature for production deployment. Estimated time for feedback review and final adjustments: 3 days.

E006.Epic Description: Facilitate secure sharing of patient health data with doctors through QR codes, enhancing the efficiency of medical consultations and patient data portability.
E006.Story Description: As a Patient, I want to be able to revoke access to the data I have shared via QR code, so that I can control the continuity of my data accessibility by doctors.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Patients must be able to select a particular doctor or hospital from their shared history and revoke access to their data.
Upon revocation, the system should immediately invalidate the previously shared QR code’s data access.
The app should notify the user upon successful revocation of access.
The system should log all revocation actions for security audits.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface component in the patient app that displays a list of all previously shared QR codes, including the details of the doctor or hospital each code was shared with. Include a date and time for each sharing instance. This task directly supports the acceptance criteria that patients must be able to select a particular doctor or hospital from their shared history.

Implement a feature in the patient app that allows users to select and revoke access to their data via a previously shared QR code. This will include an interactive button or link labeled 'Revoke Access' next to each listed QR code shared history entry. This supports the acceptance criteria for patient-initiated revocation of data access.

Develop backend functionality to invalidate a QR code's data access immediately after a patient triggers revocation. This will involve modifying the QR code's status in the database to ensure it can no longer be used for data access, thus aligning with the criteria that the system should immediately invalidate the previously shared QR code’s data access.

Create a notification system in the app to alert the patient when the revocation of a QR code has been successfully processed. This should include a confirmation message displayed in the app, satisfying the criterion that the app should notify the user upon successful revocation of access.

Set up a logging mechanism to record all QR code revocation actions.
