Each log entry should include the user ID, the QR code ID, the timestamp of the revocation, and the identifier (doctor or hospital) with whom the QR code was shared. This task is essential for meeting the acceptance criteria of logging all revocation actions for security audits.

E006.Epic Description: Facilitate secure sharing of patient health data with doctors through QR codes, enhancing the efficiency of medical consultations and patient data portability.
E006.Story Description: As a Patient, I want the QR code generation for sharing my data to be secure, ensuring that my health information remains confidential and only accessible to authorized medical personnel.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The QR code must encrypt patient data using up-to-date and strong encryption standards.
Only authorized medical personnel with the appropriate app and permissions can decrypt and view the data.
The app must generate a new QR code for each sharing action to prevent reuse of old codes.
The system should perform regular security audits to ensure the encryption methods remain secure against new vulnerabilities.

Tasks.Description: Research and select encryption algorithms that meet industry standards for securing QR code data. Ensure the chosen algorithms are current and robust against known attack vectors. This task aligns with the acceptance criteria that the QR code must encrypt patient data using up-to-date and strong encryption standards. Expected completion within 1 week.

Develop a module within the app for generating QR codes. This module should integrate the selected encryption algorithm to encrypt patient health data before encoding it into the QR code. This task aligns with the acceptance criteria regarding the encryption of patient data. Expected to be completed within 2 weeks after encryption algorithm selection.

Implement access controls within the app to ensure that only authorized medical personnel can decrypt and view the data from the QR code. This task involves setting up authentication and authorization checks based on user roles and permissions, aligning with the criteria that only authorized personnel can view the data. Completion expected within 1 week following the QR code generation module development.

Modify the QR code generation logic to ensure a new QR code is generated for each sharing action. This includes adjusting the data payload to include a timestamp or a unique identifier to differentiate each code, meeting the criteria to prevent reuse of old codes. Scheduled for 1 week of development time.

Schedule and implement regular security audits to review and assess the encryption methods used in QR code data protection. This task aligns with the acceptance criteria to regularly check the security of encryption methods. Plan for the first audit to occur one month after deployment, with subsequent quarterly audits.

Develop unit tests and integration tests to validate the encryption, generation, and decryption functionalities of the QR codes. This ensures all components work as expected and comply with security requirements. Aim to complete testing concurrently with development tasks to maintain development speed.

Prepare documentation detailing the process and protocols for QR code data encryption and access control, providing guidelines for future maintenance and compliance checks. Documentation to be completed in the final week of the development sprint.

E001.Epic Description: Develop a comprehensive dashboard for system administrators to monitor user activity, manage doctor and patient accounts, and view system statistics to ensure smooth operation of the healthcare platform.
E001.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor user activity so that I can ensure the system is used appropriately and identify any unusual behavior.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Ability to view a log of user activities including logins, logouts, and critical actions.
Activity log should include timestamps, user IDs, and descriptions of actions.
The system should update the activity log in real time.
Administrators can filter the activity log by user, date, or type of activity.

Tasks.Description: Design the database schema for the activity log, ensuring fields for user IDs, timestamps, descriptions of actions, and critical flags are included. Estimated time: 2 days.

Implement backend APIs to handle the creation and real-time updating of user activity logs. This includes logins, logouts, and critical actions. Ensure APIs are secure and can handle concurrent requests efficiently. Estimated time: 3 days.
Develop a real-time data streaming mechanism using technologies like WebSockets or server-sent events to update the admin dashboard in real-time as activities occur. Estimated time: 3 days.

Create frontend functionality on the admin dashboard to display the activity log. This should include a real-time feed and historical data access. Use a responsive table with columns for user ID, timestamp, action description, and status (critical or normal). Estimated time: 4 days.

Implement filtering capabilities in both the frontend and backend. Admins should be able to filter logs by user ID, date range, and type of activity (e.g., login, logout, critical actions). Estimated time: 2 days.

Create logging functionality in the backend that records all changes made to doctor accounts, including account creation, updates, and deactivations. Develop backend functionality to fetch and display non-health related patient profile information from the database. Ensure data fetching is optimized for performance. Task to be completed within 2 weeks.

Create functionality that allows system administrators to edit non-health related patient profile information. This includes input validation and error handling mechanisms. Schedule completion within 3 weeks.
Implement logging for all changes made to patient accounts. This includes capturing the editor's identity, time of edit, and nature of the data changed. Develop this within 1 week.

Develop a feature for administrators to deactivate or reactivate patient accounts. Include appropriate security checks and confirmation prompts to prevent accidental changes. Completion targeted within 2 weeks.

Provide alerts for any anomalies detected in system performance metrics.
Ensure the data presented is secure and accessible only to authorized administrators.

Develop back-end functionalities to fetch real-time data from the server related to user activity, system load, and transaction volumes. This includes setting up API endpoints and ensuring efficient data retrieval mechanisms. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Implement a data caching strategy to optimize the performance of the statistics dashboard, ensuring that frequent data fetches do not significantly impact system performance. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Integrate historical data comparison features by developing functionalities to fetch, process, and display trends based on past statistical data. Include date range selectors for administrators to customize views. Estimated completion time: 2 weeks.

Set up an alert system within the dashboard to notify administrators of any anomalies detected in system performance metrics such as unexpected spikes in load or transaction volumes. This task involves creating alert rules and notification mechanisms. Estimated completion time: 1.5 weeks.

Ensure data security for the statistics dashboard by implementing role-based access controls and data encryption for data in transit and at rest. Additionally, review and apply best security practices related to data visibility. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Conduct a series of performance tests to evaluate the responsiveness and accuracy of the real-time statistics display features. This testing should also include security penetration tests to ensure that data access is securely controlled. Estimated completion time: 1 week.

Track issue resolution progress and communicate updates to relevant stakeholders.
Provide a dashboard for visualizing feedback trends and common issues.

Include fields to categorize feedback (e.g., bug, feature request, general feedback). This form should validate input data to ensure security and compliance. Estimated time: 4 days.

Develop a backend system to receive, store, and categorize user feedback securely. Ensure that the storage complies with privacy regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA by implementing encryption and secure access controls. Estimated time: 6 days.

Create a feedback management interface for administrators to view and categorize feedback received. This interface should allow administrators to filter feedback by category, urgency, or date. Estimated time: 3 days.

Implement functionality for administrators to respond to feedback directly from the dashboard. Include an automated notification system to inform users once feedback has been addressed. Estimated time: 5 days.

Develop a dashboard widget to track and display issue resolution progress. This should include visual indicators such as progress bars or graphs and the ability to update and view resolution status in real-time. Estimated time: 4 days.

Set up a communication system to update relevant stakeholders about the progress of issue resolutions. This system should support both automated updates based on issue status changes and manual updates by administrators. Estimated time: 3 days.

Design and implement a comprehensive dashboard for visualizing feedback trends and common issues. This should include data aggregation tools that compile feedback into actionable insights and visualizations like charts and heat maps. Estimated time: 5 days.

System correctly restricts access based on user role.
Comprehensive testing to ensure no unauthorized access is possible.

Develop a user interface on the administrative dashboard for defining and modifying user roles. This interface should allow administrators to easily create new roles, edit existing roles, and assign or change user roles.

Implement backend functionality to support role assignment and modification. This includes creating APIs to update the user role information in the database based on inputs from the administrative dashboard.

Develop and integrate access control logic in the system that enforces role-based access restrictions across all functionalities. This should include middleware or services that check user permissions before allowing access to sensitive operations or data.

Conduct comprehensive testing to verify that the role-based access control system works as expected. This should include unit tests for individual components and integration tests that simulate real-world usage scenarios to ensure there is no unauthorized access.

Prepare and maintain documentation detailing the role-based access control system and how to manage it through the administrator dashboard. Include guidelines on how to assign roles, modify access levels, and troubleshoot common issues.

Successful login only after the second factor of authentication is verified.
Rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks.
Logging of all login attempts.

Configure the 2FA module to require successful verification of the second factor (OTP) after the initial password is deemed correct. This logic should be implemented and tested within 1 week.
Setup rate limiting mechanisms to limit the number of OTP requests a user can make within a specified time frame to prevent brute force attacks. Complete the setup and testing within 1 week.

Develop and integrate a comprehensive logging mechanism that records all login attempts, including successful and unsuccessful 2FA attempts, with timestamps and user identifiers. This should be implemented and tested thoroughly within 2 weeks.

Conduct security testing to ensure that the two-factor authentication mechanism is secure and functional, which includes penetration testing and vulnerability scanning. Allocate 2 weeks for thorough testing.

Prepare documentation that outlines the new login process with two-factor authentication, including troubleshooting steps for common issues related to 2FA. This documentation should be prepared and reviewed within 1 week.

Organize a training session for the support team on the new two-factor authentication system to ensure they can assist users effectively. Plan and execute the training session within 1 week after system implementation.

Deploy the two-factor authentication update to a staging environment for live testing with a select group of users to gather feedback and make adjustments as necessary. Set aside 2 weeks for this testing phase.

Plan and execute a full system rollout of the two-factor authentication feature, including communication to users about changes to the login process. Rollout should be completed within 1 week after successful staging tests.

System administrators can easily retrieve and view logs.

Develop a logging mechanism that captures all user actions across the system, including logins, logouts, and other significant activities. This mechanism should adhere to the designed schema and include real-time logging capabilities. Estimated duration: 3 days.

Secure access to the user management interface itself.
Capability to filter and search user list.

Regular security audits to ensure encryption is unbroken.
Training for developers on secure data handling practices.
Automated data integrity checks.

Develop the backend functionality to capture and store responses from system administrators to tickets within the database. Implement a notification system to alert users via email or in-app notifications when a response has been made to their tickets. Create a logging system to record all responses made by system administrators, including timestamp, administrator ID, ticket ID, and response content. Ensure logs are immutable and secure. This involves modifying existing logging mechanisms or building a new component. Expected completion: 4 days.

Integrate the response functionality into the existing ticket management dashboard. Visual indicators or dashboards showing overall progress of tickets

Develop reporting functionality that utilizes the categorization data. This should include generating reports based on ticket categories, which can help in analytics and directing resources appropriately. Reports should be accessible from the admin dashboard. Completion target: 2 weeks.

Ability to manually override automated routing if necessary

Gather initial user feedback on the usability of the form and make adjustments based on suggestions and user behavior observations. This may involve UI/UX tweaks to improve form interaction. Estimated review and update completion: 5 days post-launch.

E003.Epic Description: Create a system for collecting, tracking, and addressing feedback and issues reported by users. This system should allow administrators to tag and categorize issues, respond to tickets, and track resolution progress.
E003.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a dashboard that provides a quick overview of all current feedback and issues, so that I can quickly assess overall system health and user satisfaction.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard displays real-time data
Key metrics include number of open tickets, resolution time, and user satisfaction rate
Ability to drill down into specific tickets from the dashboard

Tasks.Description: Design the user interface for the dashboard that provides a quick overview of all current feedback and issues. Include sections for real-time data, key metrics, and drill-down capabilities. Ensure the design is intuitive and user-friendly. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Develop backend API to fetch real-time data including number of open tickets, resolution time, and user satisfaction rate. Ensure data is updated in real-time and can handle concurrent requests efficiently. Estimated completion: 5 days.

Implement frontend functionality for the dashboard using the designed UI. Use frameworks like React or Angular for efficient rendering and state management. Integrate with backend APIs to display real-time data. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Create a database schema to store and manage tickets with fields for status, resolution time, and user satisfaction metrics. Ensure the schema supports efficient queries for real-time data fetching. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Set up a real-time analytics engine using tools like Elasticsearch or similar to calculate and update key metrics dynamically as data changes. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Develop functionality to allow system administrators to drill down into specific tickets from the dashboard. This should include filtering and sorting capabilities to manage a large volume of tickets effectively. Estimated completion: 4 days.

Integrate user feedback mechanisms on the dashboard to collect and analyze user satisfaction data. Implement features to capture user ratings and comments directly from the dashboard interface. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Conduct thorough testing of the dashboard to ensure all features function correctly and real-time data is accurately displayed. Include unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing. Estimated completion: 3 days.

Deploy the dashboard to a production environment ensuring secure access for system administrators only. Set up monitoring and logging to observe system performance and catch potential issues early. Estimated completion: 2 days.

Train system administrators on how to use the new dashboard effectively. Prepare training materials and conduct live training sessions to cover all functionalities, including real-time data monitoring and ticket drill-down. Estimated completion: 2 days.

E004.Epic Description: Provide functionalities for system administrators to create, manage, and deactivate user accounts for doctors, ensuring appropriate access and data security.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to create user accounts for doctors so that they can access the system and manage patient data securely.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System should allow creation of doctor accounts with required fields such as MD ID, name, hospital affiliation.
Input validation for all fields must ensure data integrity.
A success message should be displayed after a successful account creation.
The system logs the account creation action for audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for creating doctor accounts. The interface should include input fields for MD ID, name, and hospital affiliation. This task should be completed within 3 days by the UI/UX team.

Implement input validation for the doctor account creation form. Validation rules should ensure that the MD ID is numeric, the name is alphanumeric, and the hospital affiliation is selected from a predefined list. This task should be completed within 2 days by the front-end development team.

Develop the backend service for processing doctor account creation. This service should receive data from the form, validate input server-side, and store the information in the database. This task should be completed within 5 days by the back-end development team.

Integrate a success message in the UI that triggers upon successful account creation. The message should be clear and user-friendly. This task must be tested and completed within 1 day by the front-end team.

Implement logging functionality that records all account creation actions. The log should include user ID, timestamp, and a description of the action. This task requires 3 days for the back-end team to complete.

Conduct a security audit on the new account creation feature to ensure data integrity and compliance with privacy standards. Prepare a report with findings and recommendations. This task should be completed within 5 days by the IT security team.

Prepare documentation for the system administrators to manage doctor accounts, detailing the process and controls in place. Include screenshots and step-by-step instructions. The documentation team should complete this task within 3 days.

Set up a testing phase where system administrators can test the new account creation functionalities in a controlled environment. Collect feedback and make necessary adjustments. This testing phase should last for 2 weeks with ongoing support from the development team.

E004.Epic Description: Provide functionalities for system administrators to create, manage, and deactivate user accounts for doctors, ensuring appropriate access and data security.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to update and manage doctor accounts to ensure the information remains accurate and relevant.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System provides an interface to view all doctor accounts in a list with edit options.
Administrator can update name, hospital affiliation, and other details.
Each update operation must be logged and traceable.
A confirmation message is displayed after successful updates.

Tasks.Description: Design a user interface for administrators to view all doctor accounts in a list format. Include sort and filter options to facilitate easy navigation. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Implement backend API endpoints to retrieve doctor account data from the database. Ensure endpoints support pagination, sorting, and filtering based on parameters such as name and hospital affiliation. Estimated completion time: 3 days.
Develop front-end functionality to connect with the backend API and display the list of doctor accounts. Implement dynamic loading and error handling. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Create an edit form for each doctor account listed. The form should include fields for name, hospital affiliation, and other pertinent details. Ensure fields have proper validation rules. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Implement backend logic to handle the submission of updated doctor account details. Ensure that the API checks for proper authorization and validates all input before updating the database. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Create a logging mechanism to record each update operation made to doctor accounts. Include details such as the administrator's user ID, timestamp, and nature of the changes. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Integrate a confirmation message pop-up in the UI that triggers after successful updates. The message should confirm the successful update and display any relevant information or errors. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

Conduct unit testing to ensure that the interface functions correctly and all data handling is secure. Test cases should include tests for API security, data validation, and user feedback mechanisms. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Arrange a review session with the stakeholders to demonstrate the updated management interface and gather feedback. Implement any necessary adjustments based on the feedback received. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

E004.Epic Description: Provide functionalities for system administrators to create, manage, and deactivate user accounts for doctors, ensuring appropriate access and data security.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to deactivate doctor accounts to restrict access when necessary for security or administrative reasons.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System allows the administrator to deactivate an account from the manage accounts page.
Deactivated accounts should no longer be able to access the system.
A success message should confirm the deactivation.
The deactivation action must be logged for audit purposes.

Tasks.Description: Design a UI component in the admin dashboard to list all active doctor accounts with options to deactivate. Include a 'Deactivate' button next to each account entry. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Implement backend service to handle deactivation requests. This service should change the account status to 'inactive' and prevent any further system access. Estimated completion: 3 days.
Develop a confirmation mechanism that prompts the administrator to confirm the deactivation before proceeding. This prevents accidental deactivation. Estimated completion: 1 day.
Upon successful deactivation, display a success message to the administrator confirming that the account has been deactivated. Estimated completion: 1 day.

Create a logging mechanism to record all deactivation actions. This log should include the administrator's user ID, timestamp, and the doctor's account ID affected by the deactivation. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Perform integration testing to ensure that deactivated accounts cannot log in or access the system post-deactivation. Estimated completion: 2 days.
Conduct security testing to validate that the deactivation feature is secure and that logs are written correctly and stored securely. Estimated completion: 2 days.

E004.Epic Description: Provide functionalities for system administrators to create, manage, and deactivate user accounts for doctors, ensuring appropriate access and data security.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to reset passwords for doctor accounts to assist with account recovery and maintain account security.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System allows administrators to initiate a password reset for any doctor account.
A temporary password is generated and emailed to the doctor’s registered email address.
The system logs the password reset action.
Doctor is prompted to change the password upon next login.

Tasks.Description: Design a password reset feature within the system's administration interface that allows administrators to initiate password resets for doctor accounts. Include a clear 'Reset Password' button next to each doctor's account listing. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Develop the backend functionality to generate a temporary, secure, and random password when an administrator initiates a password reset. Ensure the temporary password meets security standards (e.g., length, complexity). Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Implement email integration to automatically send the temporary password to the doctor’s registered email address. The email should include instructions for logging in and changing the password. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Update the system's logging mechanism to record password reset actions, including the administrator's user ID, the affected doctor’s account, and the timestamp of the action. Ensure that the log is secure and only accessible to authorized personnel. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

Modify the doctor's login workflow to prompt for a password change upon login with a temporary password. This should include a user interface for entering a new password and confirming it. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Conduct comprehensive testing of the password reset functionality to ensure it works as expected under various scenarios like incorrect email addresses, security breaches, and network failures. Include both automated and manual testing approaches. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Prepare and update system documentation to include details about the new password reset process, covering steps for both administrators and doctors. Ensure clear instructions are provided for secure password creation. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

Schedule a training session for system administrators to educate them on how to manage the password reset process, including understanding the log data and handling user inquiries related to password resets. Estimated completion time: 1 day.

E004.Epic Description: Provide functionalities for system administrators to create, manage, and deactivate user accounts for doctors, ensuring appropriate access and data security.
E004.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to view logs of all account-related activities to monitor and audit usage and modifications by other administrators.
Story Acceptance Criteria: System provides a secure section to view logs of account activities including creation, updates, deactivation, and password resets.
Logs should include date, time, user ID of the admin who performed the action, and the nature of the action.
Logs should be searchable by date range and type of activity.
System should display logs in a readable and organized manner.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema for logging account-related activities including account creation, updates, deactivation, and password resets. Include fields for date, time, user ID, nature of action, and other relevant metadata. Set up indexing to optimize search operations.

Develop a secure backend API that captures account-related activities and stores them in the logging database. Ensure all relevant actions within the account management module trigger appropriate logging with detailed information.

Create a user interface in the admin dashboard for viewing logs of account-related activities. This interface should include filters for date range and type of activity, and display results in a readable and organized manner.
Implement search functionality in the log viewing interface that allows administrators to search logs based on custom criteria such as date range, user ID, and type of activity.
Ensure security measures are in place to restrict access to the logs, allowing only authorized system administrators to view them. Implement authentication checks and encryption as necessary.
Conduct thorough testing of the logging system to ensure accuracy of the data captured, effectiveness of the search functionality, and compliance with security requirements.
Prepare documentation on how to use the logging system within the admin dashboard, including details on how to perform searches and interpret log entries.

E005.Epic Description: Develop tools for monitoring the health and performance of the system, including real-time analytics and automated alerts to notify administrators of potential issues or downtimes.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a dashboard that displays real-time analytics of the system's health so that I can monitor performance metrics and system statuses continuously.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time.
Displays key performance metrics such as CPU usage, memory usage, network status, and disk space.
Has a section for viewing the current status of all servers and critical services.
Accessible via web interface on multiple devices.

Tasks.Description: Research and select real-time monitoring tools and libraries compatible with the existing system architecture that can monitor CPU usage, memory usage, network status, and disk space. Completion target: 3 days from start date.

Design a schema for the dashboard that includes sections for each of the key performance metrics (CPU usage, memory usage, network status, disk space) and a separate section for the current status of all servers and critical services. Completion target: 5 days from approval of tools.

Develop front-end components for the dashboard using a responsive web design to ensure accessibility via multiple devices. Incorporate data visualization libraries for metric displays. Completion target: 10 days from schema approval.

Implement back-end services to continuously fetch and push real-time data to the front-end dashboard components. Ensure that data fetching processes are optimized for minimal latency. Completion target: 15 days from front-end components completion.

Set up a testing environment to simulate real-time data updates on the dashboard and validate the performance of the dashboard under varying loads. Completion target: 5 days from back-end service implementation.

Conduct cross-device compatibility testing to ensure the dashboard is accessible and functional across different web-capable devices. Address any UI/UX issues that arise during testing. Completion target: 5 days from initial testing phase completion.

Prepare and deliver a training session for the system administrators on how to use the new dashboard, emphasizing the real-time updates and sections specific to server status and critical services. Completion target: 3 days after passing all testing phases.

Deploy the dashboard to the production environment after obtaining approval from the project stakeholders. Include rollback procedures in case of deployment issues. Completion target: 2 days after training completion.
Monitor the dashboard performance post-deployment and collect feedback from system administrators to identify any potential improvements or necessary adjustments. Ongoing for 30 days post-deployment.

E005.Epic Description: Develop tools for monitoring the health and performance of the system, including real-time analytics and automated alerts to notify administrators of potential issues or downtimes.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to receive automated alerts when the system detects failures or abnormalities so that I can respond promptly to potential issues.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Alerts are triggered by predefined conditions such as service downtime, performance degradation, or error rates exceeding normal thresholds.
Alerts are delivered via email and SMS.
Provides a clear description of the issue within the alert.
Includes time of detection and affected components in the alert.

Tasks.Description: Define the list of system failures and abnormalities that should trigger alerts, including service downtime, performance degradation, and abnormal error rates. Deadline: 1 week from project start.

Develop a monitoring system capable of detecting the predefined conditions. This includes integrating or enhancing existing monitoring tools to capture real-time data on system performance, error rates, and service status. Deadline: 3 weeks from project start.

Implement an alert system using a reliable third-party service or in-house solution that supports multi-channel notifications, including email and SMS. Evaluate multiple services for reliability and integration ease. Deadline: 2 weeks from project start.

Set up the mechanics for the alert notifications to include concise, clear descriptions of the issue detected, the time of detection, and the affected system components. Ensure the alerts contain actionable information for quick resolution. Deadline: 2 weeks after the monitoring system is in place.

Integrate the alert system with the monitoring tools to automatically trigger alerts when predefined conditions are met. Include data points like time of detection and affected components in the alert messages. Deadline: 3 weeks after the monitoring system is in place.

Test the complete alert system to ensure that it works as expected under different scenarios such as simulated service downtime, performance degradation, and high error rates. This should verify both detection and notification functionalities. Deadline: 1 week after alert system integration.

Deploy the alert system to the production environment and monitor its performance for the initial month, tweaking thresholds and parameters as needed based on the alerts generated and feedback from system administrators. Deadline: 1 month after system deployment.

Prepare and deliver training sessions for system administrators on how to respond to alerts, including steps for further investigation and resolution. Include guidelines on logging and documenting incidents arising from alerts. Deadline: 2 weeks after system deployment.

E005.Epic Description: Develop tools for monitoring the health and performance of the system, including real-time analytics and automated alerts to notify administrators of potential issues or downtimes.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a centralized log management tool that aggregates logs from all system components so that I can troubleshoot and analyze issues efficiently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Supports aggregation of logs from various sources including servers, applications, and databases.
Allows filtering and searching of log data by time range, severity, or keywords.
Provides options to download logs for offline analysis.
Real-time log updates and display.

Tasks.Description: Design and develop a centralized log aggregation system that collects logs from various sources including servers, applications, and databases. Allocate 3 weeks for completion.
Implement filtering capabilities in the log aggregation system to allow users to filter logs by time range, severity, or keywords. Schedule 1 week for this task.
Develop functionality within the log management tool that provides options for users to download logs for offline analysis. Estimate 1 week for development.
Ensure that the log management tool updates and displays logs in real-time. This task should include setup of the necessary backend services and UI updates, with a timeframe of 2 weeks.

Conduct a testing phase to ensure that all functionalities of the log management tool, including aggregation, filtering, download, and real-time display, work according to the requirements. Allocate 2 weeks for thorough testing.
Prepare and deliver a training session for system administrators to demonstrate how to use the new log management tool effectively. Plan for a 1-day training session after the deployment of the tool.
Deploy the log management tool to the production environment and monitor its performance for 1 week to ensure stability and proper operation.

E005.Epic Description: Develop tools for monitoring the health and performance of the system, including real-time analytics and automated alerts to notify administrators of potential issues or downtimes.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a tool that analyzes and displays performance trends over time so that I can identify potential issues before they become critical.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Generates reports on performance metrics over customizable time frames.
Identifies and highlights performance degradation trends.
Supports visualization of data through graphs and charts.
Allows for automated weekly or monthly performance reporting.

Tasks.Description: Design a data model for storing performance metrics with attributes for timestamps, metric types, and values.
Develop a backend service to collect and store performance metrics from various system components at configurable intervals.
Implement a metrics aggregation logic that compiles data across different time frames (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly) for reporting.
Create algorithms to analyze collected data and identify trends of performance degradation over time.
Develop a front-end component for visualizing performance metrics using graphs and charts, integrating with existing system dashboards.
Implement a reporting feature that allows administrators to generate and download performance reports in various formats (e.g., PDF, Excel).
Schedule and automate the generation of weekly and monthly performance reports, with email notifications to administrators upon completion.
Conduct a testing phase to ensure the accuracy of performance trends and the reliability of automated reporting features.
Prepare documentation for system administrators on how to use the new performance trend analysis tool and interpret the reports generated.

E005.Epic Description: Develop tools for monitoring the health and performance of the system, including real-time analytics and automated alerts to notify administrators of potential issues or downtimes.
E005.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want a feature to monitor user activities and access within the system to ensure security and compliance with policies.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Tracks and records all user login sessions and activities.
Provides alerts on unauthorized access attempts.
Allows administrators to view reports of user activities.
Supports filtering activity logs by user, date, and type of activity.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a database schema to store user activity logs, including fields for user ID, action type, timestamp, and description. Ensure the database supports efficient querying by user, date, and action type. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Develop a backend service to capture and record user activities in real-time. This service should hook into existing user actions across the system to log all login sessions, modifications, and other significant activities. Estimated completion time: 5 days.

Implement a secure API endpoint for fetching activity logs from the database. The endpoint should require system administrator authentication and support filtering parameters such as user ID, date range, and action type. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Create an alert system to notify system administrators of unauthorized access attempts. This should include real-time monitoring of login attempts and triggers alerts if suspicious patterns are detected, such as multiple failed login attempts. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Develop a user-friendly dashboard interface for system administrators to view and filter user activity logs. The dashboard should allow administrators to easily sort and filter activities by user, date, and type, and view detailed information about each activity. Estimated completion time: 5 days.

Integrate the user activity tracking system with existing system logs to provide a comprehensive view of all user interactions with the system, enhancing the ability to monitor and secure the platform. Estimated completion time: 3 days.

Conduct a security review and testing phase to ensure that the user activity logging and alert system is secure from external threats and meets compliance requirements. This includes penetration testing and code review. Estimated completion time: 4 days.

Prepare documentation for the system administrators on how to use the new dashboard and alerts system, including details on how to interpret the logs and respond to alerts. Estimated completion time: 2 days.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want an audit log feature so that I can track all user activities related to data access and modifications within the system to ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations.
Story Acceptance Criteria: Each user action related to data access or modification must be logged with a timestamp.
Logs should include user ID, action type, date/time, and affected data fields.
The system must provide a secure way to access and search through these logs.
Logs cannot be modified or deleted by any user.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a secure logging system that captures all user actions related to data access or modification in the healthcare platform. Each entry must include a timestamp, user ID, action type, date/time, and affected data fields. Ensure that the logging functionality is integrated with existing data access mechanisms to automatically capture this information.

Develop a role-based access system for the audit logs to ensure only authorized system administrators can access this sensitive information. Implement strict authentication and authorization checks before granting access to the logs.

Create a user interface for the audit log that allows system administrators to easily search through and filter logs by user ID, action type, date/time, and data fields. The interface should be intuitive and provide advanced search capabilities to quickly locate specific log entries.

Implement security measures to protect the integrity and immutability of the audit logs. Use cryptographic techniques to ensure that logs cannot be modified or deleted by any users, including administrators. Regularly test these security measures through penetration testing and security audits.

Set up automated alerts and notifications for system administrators when critical data access or modifications are logged. These alerts should help in proactively monitoring potential compliance issues or data breaches.

Schedule and conduct regular training sessions for all new and existing system administrators about the importance of audit logs and how to effectively use the audit log system to monitor and ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations.
Integrate the audit log system with the existing healthcare platform's back-end architecture, ensuring minimal impact on system performance and user experience.
Document the audit log system's design, functionalities, user manual, and best practices in the system's knowledge base to assist system administrators in using the system effectively.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to receive notifications about changes in HIPAA regulations so that I can ensure the platform updates its compliance measures in a timely manner.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system should integrate with an external HIPAA compliance notification service.
Notifications about compliance updates must be automatically pushed to administrators.
The system should log all received compliance updates and actions taken by administrators.

Tasks.Description: Research and select a reliable HIPAA compliance notification service to integrate with the platform. Ensure the service provides real-time updates on HIPAA regulations. Set a deadline for selection and integration plan within 2 weeks.

Develop an integration module to connect the chosen HIPAA compliance notification service with the platform. This should include API integration that pulls compliance updates and pushes them into the platform's notification system. Aim to complete the development and initial testing within 3 weeks.

Implement a notification system within the platform to automatically alert administrators of any HIPAA compliance updates received from the service. Notifications should be visible on the admin dashboard and optionally sent via email. Schedule implementation to be completed in 1 week.

Create a logging system to record all received HIPAA compliance updates and the actions taken by administrators in response to these updates. This system must ensure that logs are secure, immutable, and searchable. Plan to complete the logging system within 2 weeks.

Conduct a comprehensive testing phase to ensure that the integration works seamlessly, notifications are correctly pushed to administrators, and logging functions as required. This testing should cover edge cases and failure scenarios. Allocate 1 week for complete testing.

Prepare and deliver training sessions for administrators on how to use the new features for monitoring HIPAA compliance updates. Include guidelines on how to respond to notifications and the importance of logging actions. Schedule training sessions to be completed within 1 week after system deployment.

Set up a feedback mechanism to collect insights from administrators on the usability and effectiveness of the HIPAA compliance notification integration. Use this feedback to make iterative improvements. Initiate feedback collection to start immediately after training and continue for 4 weeks.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to manage user roles and permissions so that access to sensitive health data is strictly controlled according to HIPAA standards.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must support different user roles with specific access permissions.
Administrators should be able to add, remove, or modify user roles and permissions without system downtime.
Role changes should be logged in the audit trail.

Tasks.Description: Design a user role management module capable of creating, viewing, and editing roles with specific permissions. Include roles like System Administrator, Doctor, and Patient, each with unique access permissions.
Implement a user interface in the admin dashboard for managing user roles and permissions, ensuring it allows adding, removing, or modifying roles seamlessly.

Develop backend logic to support dynamic changes in user roles and permissions without causing system downtime. This includes API endpoints to handle requests for creating, deleting, or updating user roles.

Set up an audit trail system to log all changes made to user roles and permissions. Ensure that each log entry includes user ID, action taken, timestamp, and the previous and new values of the role or permission changed.
Perform comprehensive testing on the user role management functionality to ensure it operates without system downtime and logs actions accurately in the audit trail.
Conduct security testing to verify that the role changes do not inadvertently grant unauthorized access and that all changes are properly authenticated and authorized.

Prepare documentation for the user role management system detailing how to use the interface, the impact of each role and permission, and guidelines for secure management of roles according to HIPAA standards.
Organize a training session for system administrators to familiarize them with the new user role management tools, focusing on how to handle role assignments compliantly with HIPAA regulations.

Deploy the user role management functionality to the staging environment and perform end-to-end testing with simulated real-world scenarios to ensure all features work as expected and comply with HIPAA standards.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to configure data encryption so that all stored and transmitted patient data is secure against unauthorized access.
Story Acceptance Criteria: All patient data stored in the database must be encrypted at rest.
All data transmissions must be encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
Administrators should have tools to verify and modify encryption settings.

Tasks.Description: Research and select industry-standard encryption protocols suitable for encrypting patient data at rest and in transit, ensuring compatibility with existing systems. Completion expected within 1 week.

Develop and implement encryption mechanisms for all patient data stored in the database (at rest encryption). This includes implementing encryption libraries and configuring database encryption settings. Task to be completed within 2 weeks.
Integrate secure transmission protocols (such as TLS) to ensure that all data sent over the network is encrypted (in transit encryption). The task should be executed and tested within 2 weeks.

Create a user interface for administrators in the admin dashboard to monitor and configure encryption settings. Include features such as viewing current encryption status and updating encryption protocols if needed. This should be ready for initial review in 3 weeks.

Conduct a series of tests to verify the security and effectiveness of the new encryption implementations. This includes penetration testing and vulnerability scanning. Complete testing phase by the end of the 4th week.

Prepare and conduct a training session for system administrators to educate them on how to use the new tools for verifying and modifying encryption settings. Schedule the session for the end of the 5th week.
Document the encryption protocols implemented and the procedures for managing these settings in the system administrator's manual. Documentation to be completed and reviewed by end of the 6th week.
Set up an automated alert system to notify administrators of any encryption failures or unauthorized attempts to modify encryption settings. Implementation should be completed within 3 weeks.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to implement compliance training modules so that all new and existing users are regularly trained on HIPAA compliance requirements.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system must provide modules that cover all relevant aspects of HIPAA.
Training progress and completion must be tracked for each user.
Administrators should be able to assign, schedule, and monitor training sessions.
Reminders for training should be automatically generated by the system.

Tasks.Description: Research and document key aspects of HIPAA compliance that must be covered in the training modules. Ensure coverage is comprehensive and up-to-date. This task should be completed within 1 week by the compliance officer.

Develop an interactive training module that includes multimedia elements such as videos, quizzes, and downloadable content covering all identified aspects of HIPAA. Assign this task to the content development team with a deadline of 3 weeks.

Implement a tracking system in the training platform that records each user's progress and completion of the training modules. The tracking system should be developed by the IT team and completed within 2 weeks.

Create functionalities for administrators to assign training modules to users, schedule training sessions, and monitor completion. This should include an administrative dashboard with user progress indicators and should be developed within 4 weeks by the software development team.

Develop an automated reminder system that notifies users of scheduled training sessions and sends follow-up reminders for incomplete modules. This system should integrate with the existing email and notification services and be completed within 2 weeks by the software development team.

E006.Epic Description: Ensure that the platform remains compliant with HIPAA and other relevant health data regulations, providing system administrators with the tools needed to audit, update, and maintain compliance.
E006.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to schedule and conduct regular compliance audits so that the platform adheres to all necessary HIPAA requirements consistently.
Story Acceptance Criteria: The system should allow administrators to schedule audits at regular intervals.
Audit results must be logged and accessible to authorized administrators.
The system should provide a checklist of HIPAA compliance measures to assess during each audit.

Tasks.Description: Design and implement a scheduling mechanism within the system that allows administrators to configure and automate the timing of compliance audits. Ensure that the scheduling feature supports various intervals such as monthly, quarterly, and yearly audits. Completion due within 3 weeks.

Develop a logging system for audit results. This system should capture comprehensive details of each audit, including the date, time, scope, and findings. The log should be immutable to ensure data integrity and be stored in a secure manner. Aim to complete this task within 4 weeks.

Create a comprehensive checklist of HIPAA compliance measures. This checklist will be used during each audit to assess the platform's adherence to regulations. The checklist should be dynamically updateable to accommodate changes in HIPAA regulations. Task to be finalized in 2 weeks.

Implement role-based access control for the audit logs to ensure that only authorized administrators can access the sensitive data. Include capabilities for administrators to view, search, and filter the audit logs based on various parameters such as date range and type of audit. Expected to complete within 3 weeks.

Set up automated notifications for administrators to alert them of upcoming and completed audits. These notifications should be configurable according to the preferences of individual administrators. Target to implement this feature within 1 week.

Conduct a security review of the newly developed features, especially focusing on the logging mechanism and access controls, to ensure they meet industry standard security practices. Plan for this review to be completed within 2 weeks after all features are developed.

Prepare documentation for the new compliance audit features, detailing operation, configuration, and troubleshooting steps. Ensure the documentation is clear and accessible to system administrators. Completion targeted within 1 week after feature completion.

E007.Epic Description: Enable system administrators to manage and configure settings for third-party integrations such as OpenAI and Twilio, ensuring seamless operation and integration reliability.

E008.Story Description: As a System Administrator, I want to set up real-time data replication, so that all data is immediately copied to a backup server, ensuring no data loss.

Failover to backup server in case of primary server failure with seamless transition.
Regular status reports on replication health.
